items.title: 沙烏地攔截胡塞飛彈！川普威脅再次對伊朗發動軍事行動、美伊衝突升溫推高油價
items.title_en: Saudi Arabia Intercepts Houthi Missile! Trump Threatens New Military Action Against Iran, US‑Iran Tensions Lift Oil Prices
paras: 中東局勢再度升溫，沙烏地阿拉伯周六（24日）攔截一枚以首都利雅德為目標的胡塞組織彈道飛彈。隨著美國總統川普再度威脅對伊朗採取軍事行動，加上區域攻擊持續，市場對衝突擴大的憂慮升高，國際油價也大幅上揚。
根據《Investing.com》報導，由沙烏地阿拉伯領導的聯軍表示，利雅德、奈季蘭及瓦迪達瓦西爾發布緊急警報後，防空系統成功摧毀該枚飛彈。當局隨後宣布危險解除。
聯軍另稱，在沙烏地東部省上空攔截一架無人機；與胡塞組織有關的媒體則報導，葉門薩達省再度遭到空襲。
這波區域安全事件發生之際，川普警告華府可能再次對伊朗發動軍事行動，並提及今年2月展開的「史詩怒火行動」（Operation Epic Fury）。
美國駐土耳其大使Tom Barrack另表示，攻擊行動最快可能在本周末發生，但川普隨後表示，他對這類計畫一無所知。
不斷升高的軍事威脅已對能源市場造成明顯衝擊。布蘭特原油周五（23日）升至每桶117.30美元，美國西德州中級原油則漲至每桶103美元，市場擔憂能源供應可能受到干擾。
根據《路透》報導所引用的華盛頓研究所數據，若以已確認的攻擊次數衡量，10月也已成為荷姆茲海峽商業航運安全情勢最嚴峻的月份，迄今至少有28起船舶遇襲事件。
該研究所統計，自2月以來，相關攻擊事件已累計113起；國際海事組織（IMO）記錄的事件則達120起。
美國駐聯合國大使Mike Waltz表示，華府可能在可預見的未來持續對伊朗實施海上封鎖。
儘管軍事威脅升高，外交努力仍在進行。國際原子能總署（IAEA）署長Rafael Grossi表示，該機構在技術上已準備好恢復對伊朗核計畫的查核工作，並強調有必要透過談判達成協議。
伊朗常駐聯合國副代表則表示，德黑蘭並未放棄履行核子保障義務，但也以安全疑慮為由，說明核查人員返回伊朗面臨的問題。
伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚（Masoud Pezeshkian）預計下周在莫斯科出席天然氣出口國峰會期間，與俄羅斯總統普丁會面。
另一邊，以色列在約旦河西岸的軍事與安全措施也進一步升級。一場發生在希伯崙附近的槍擊事件造成兩名以色列士兵死亡後，以色列對遭占領的約旦河西岸實施大範圍限制。
以色列總理納坦雅胡（Benjamin Netanyahu）揚言展開大規模軍事行動，以軍則持續在當地進行突襲與拆除行動。
paras_en: Middle‑East tensions rose again on Saturday (the 24th) when Saudi Arabia intercepted a Houthi ballistic missile aimed at the capital Riyadh. As former U.S. President Donald Trump again threatened military action against Iran and regional attacks continued, market worries about a widening conflict grew, sending international oil prices sharply higher.

According to Investing.com, the Saudi‑led coalition said that after emergency alerts were issued in Riyadh, Najran and Wadi ad‑Dawasir, the air‑defence system successfully destroyed the missile. Authorities later announced that the danger had been cleared.
The coalition also reported that a drone was intercepted over the eastern province of Saudi Arabia; Houthi‑linked media said Yemen’s Saada province was hit by another air strike.
The regional security incidents came as Trump warned that Washington could launch another military operation against Iran, citing the “Operation Epic Fury” that began in February this year.
U.S. ambassador to Turkey Tom Barrack added that an attack could occur as early as this weekend, but Trump later said he knew nothing about such plans.

The rising military threat has visibly impacted energy markets. Brent crude rose on Friday the 23rd to $117.30 a barrel, while U.S. West Texas Intermediate climbed to $103 a barrel, as markets fear possible disruptions to energy supplies.

Reuters, citing data from the Washington Institute, reported that October has already become the most dangerous month for commercial shipping in the Hormuz Strait, with at least 28 vessel‑attack incidents recorded so far.
The institute’s statistics show that since February there have been 113 related attacks; the International Maritime Organization (IMO) has logged 120 incidents.
U.S. ambassador to the United Nations Mike Waltz said Washington may continue to impose a maritime blockade on Iran in the foreseeable future.

Despite the heightened military threat, diplomatic efforts continue. IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi said the agency is technically ready to resume inspections of Iran’s nuclear program and stressed the need to reach an agreement through negotiations.
Iran’s deputy UN representative said Tehran has not abandoned its nuclear safeguard obligations but cited security concerns that make it difficult for inspectors to return to Iran.
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian is expected to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin next week in Moscow during the natural‑gas exporters summit.

Meanwhile, Israel has further escalated its military and security measures in the West Bank. After a shooting near Hebron that killed two Israeli soldiers, Israel imposed broad restrictions on the occupied West Bank.
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu warned of a large‑scale military operation, and the Israeli army continues raids and demolition activities in the area.

items.title: 法國繃緊神經迎新一波示威 7萬維安人力出動 精品店封窗、羅浮宮閉館
items.title_en: France Tightens Security Ahead of New Wave of Protests, Deploys 70,000 Security Personnel; Boutique Windows Boarded, Louvre Closed
paras: 法國週六(24日)迎來新一波示威，引發外界憂心上週末的暴亂恐再度上演。
法國內政部長努涅茲（Laurent Nunez）週五向記者表示，政府誓言遏止任何暴力行為，將部署7萬名維安人員，包括反恐精銳部隊。他指控極左派透過社群媒體號召暴力行動。
巴黎商家，包括精品店，已用木板封住櫥窗並增聘保全，部分店家將暫停營業。羅浮宮、奧賽美術館及畢卡索美術館等三座熱門博物館，週六也將閉館。原定在巴黎舉行的巴黎聖日耳曼對里昂足球賽則已延期。
努涅茲表示：「對於滋事者、搶劫者及任何施暴者，包括極左派政治團體，我們絕不妥協。」
他強調，警方已準備好應對暴亂。軍方將協助守衛敏感建築，直升機、水砲車及名為「半人馬」（Centaurs）的裝甲車也將待命。里昂等部分城市已禁止週六舉行示威，並延長宵禁。
民怨指向馬克宏 極右派支持度受惠
法國總統馬克宏週四承認，上週末的維安部署存在「規劃疏失與始料未及的狀況」。當時逾50萬人上街抗議，示威隨後演變成破壞行動，暴徒在全國各地攻擊公共建築、洗劫商店。
馬克宏已延後原定的西非訪問行程，並指控極左派團體發動他所稱的煽動叛亂行為。
週六的示威獲得社群媒體人士、學生、工會及左派政黨等不同群體支持，被定位為這場運動的「第二幕」（Acte II），訴求包括改善公共服務，以及要求政府協助民眾因應生活成本。
大部分怒火指向馬克宏；距離第二任期結束僅剩六個月，他的民意支持度已跌至歷來最低。
民調顯示，暴力事件有利於極右派候選人雷朋（Marine Le Pen），她目前在明年大選中居於領先。雷朋週六將在法國中部城市奧爾良召集數千名支持者，出席國民聯盟黨代表大會，反對她的群眾也將前往抗議，進一步加劇緊張情勢。
財政疑慮升溫 法德公債利差擴大
這波動盪也加深外界對法國公共財政的疑慮。雖然法國週五晚間躲過穆迪信評降評，但在2027年大選前，仍難以縮減預算赤字。
一項備受關注的債券風險指標已升至歐債危機以來未見的水準。法國與被視為歐洲安全資產的德國10年期公債殖利率差，週四擴大至178個基點，遠高於9月初的85個基點。
法國民間企業經濟活動本月也陷入萎縮。標普全球編製的綜合採購經理人指數（PMI），由上月的51.1降至10月的48.4，跌破區分景氣擴張與萎縮的50榮枯線。
歐洲多國也面臨抗議潮
法國並非唯一面臨民眾動盪的歐洲國家。義大利米蘭與羅馬預計週末將出現學生及其他青年發起的示威。米蘭上週末的抗議演變成搶劫與暴亂後，義大利政府表示將派遣軍隊進駐。
比利時也預計出現抗議活動；阿爾巴尼亞則因民眾不滿總理拉瑪（Edi Rama）的執政，由學生主導的暴力示威已進入第二週。
paras_en: France on Saturday (the 24th) faced a new wave of demonstrations, raising concerns that the riots of last weekend could recur.

Interior Minister Laurent Nunez told reporters on Friday that the government is determined to curb any violence, deploying 70,000 security personnel, including elite anti‑terror units. He accused far‑left groups of using social media to call for violent actions.

Paris merchants, including boutique owners, have boarded up shop windows with wooden planks and hired extra security, with some stores suspending operations. The Louvre, the Musée d'Orsay and the Musée Picasso will also be closed on Saturday, and the scheduled Paris Saint‑Germain versus Lyon football match has been postponed.
Nunez said, "We will not compromise with troublemakers, looters or any perpetrators of violence, including far‑left political groups."

He stressed that police are ready to handle riots. The military will help guard sensitive buildings, with helicopters, water‑cannon trucks and armored vehicles called "Centaurs" on standby. Cities such as Lyon have banned Saturday demonstrations and extended curfews.
Public discontent is turning against President Macron, boosting support for the far‑right.

President Emmanuel Macron admitted on Thursday that the security deployment last weekend suffered from "planning oversights and unforeseen circumstances." More than 500,000 people took to the streets, and the protests later turned into vandalism, with rioters attacking public buildings and looting shops across the country.
Macron has postponed his planned visit to West Africa and accused far‑left groups of inciting what he called a rebellion.

Saturday's protest draws support from social‑media users, students, unions and left‑wing parties and is framed as the "Acte II" of the movement, demanding better public services and government help with the cost of living.
Most of the anger is aimed at Macron; with only six months left in his second term, his approval rating has fallen to a historic low.

Polls show that the violence is benefiting far‑right candidate Marine Le Pen, who currently leads in next year’s election. Le Pen will rally thousands of supporters in Orléans on Saturday for a National Rally party congress, while opposing crowds are expected to protest, further heightening tensions.
Fiscal concerns rise as the France‑Germany sovereign‑bond yield spread widens
The turmoil deepens doubts about France’s public finances. Although Moody’s avoided a downgrade on Friday night, trimming the budget deficit before the 2027 election remains difficult.

A key bond‑risk indicator has risen to its highest level since the Euro‑zone debt crisis. The spread between French and German 10‑year government bond yields widened to 178 basis points on Thursday, up from 85 basis points in early September.

French private‑sector activity also contracted this month. S&P Global’s composite Purchasing Managers' Index fell from 51.1 last month to 48.4 in October, slipping below the 50 threshold that separates expansion from contraction.
Several European nations also face protest waves

France is not the only European country dealing with public unrest. Italy’s Milan and Rome are expected to see student‑led and youth demonstrations this weekend. After Milan’s protests turned into robberies and riots last weekend, the Italian government said it will deploy troops.
Belgium is also expected to see protests, and in Albania, violent student‑led demonstrations against Prime Minister Edi Rama’s government have entered a second week.

items.title: Anthropic會延後「超級IPO」嗎？AI股回檔添變數、時程相當緊迫
items.title_en: Will Anthropic Delay Its "Super IPO"? AI Stocks Pull Back Adds Uncertainty, Timeline Very Tight
paras: 人工智慧（AI）新創公司Anthropic傳出計畫於11月中旬完成首次公開發行（IPO），目標估值高達2兆美元，有望成為史上規模最大的科技IPO之一。不過，近期AI概念股遭遇賣壓，加上美國證券交易委員會（SEC）對招股文件公開時間的要求，讓Anthropic的上市時程面臨壓力。
根據《路透》報導，依規定，公司必須在上市路演開始至少15天前公開提交招股說明書（S-1文件），因此若要趕上原定時程，留給Anthropic準備的時間已相當有限。
若Anthropic以2兆美元估值上市，規模將超越SpaceX(SPCX-US) 今年稍早1.77兆美元的上市規模。
與此同時，市場近期對AI產業支出能否持續的疑慮也持續升高。新興雲端運算公司CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 股價在兩周內下跌約30%，記憶體大廠美光科技(MU-US) 近一個月則下跌17%。
市場人士認為，這波回檔可能影響Anthropic的上市決策，但公司對資金的需求，也可能促使其繼續推進IPO計畫。
預測市場目前估計，Anthropic年底前上市的機率約為80%。
佛羅里達大學IPO研究計畫負責人Jay Ritter表示，若Anthropic希望在感恩節前完成上市，時間仍然充裕，但時程已相當緊迫。
若公司將IPO日期訂在最晚11月24日，並於11月16日啟動路演，就必須在下周末前公開提交S-1文件。
Anthropic先前原本被預期會在美國勞工節後不久公開招股說明書，市場當時一度預估公司可能於9月下旬掛牌，但最終並未如期推進。

AI股遭拋售　市場憂支出與融資前景

根據《MarketWatch》報導，近期AI相關股票大幅修正，是Anthropic管理層必須納入考量的重要因素。
因市場擔憂CoreWeave債務管理能力，該公司股價兩周內下跌約30%；美光近一個月跌幅則達17%，反映投資人對AI支出規模及融資前景的疑慮升溫。
Rational Equity Armor Fund投資組合經理Joe Tigay也指出，持續的通膨壓力與高漲的能源價格同樣令人擔憂。
他認為，從歷史經驗來看，經濟成長放緩與通膨並存，往往是股市出現問題的前兆。若相關壓力持續累積，Anthropic可能選擇暫緩上市，留在私人市場等待更有利的時機。
不過，也有市場人士認為，Anthropic成功上市有助於重振投資人對AI產業的信心。
Cerity Partners首席市場策略師Jim Lebenthal表示，市場近期對AI產業的長期發展潛力與商業模式提出更多質疑，因此需要一場成功的Anthropic IPO，證明AI產業具備持續發展的能力。
他指出，市場提出疑問甚至產生懷疑並不為過，但美國股市與整體經濟的健康，在很大程度上仍取決於AI產業能否成功。

AI算力支出龐大　資金需求成上市推力

分析指出，除了市場環境，Anthropic自身對資金的迫切需求，也可能是推動公司如期上市的關鍵因素。
Zacks Investment Research股票策略師Andrew Rocco表示，大型AI公司已展現出願意大規模投入資金的態度，希望藉此吸引更多用戶，並爭取成為市場主導者。
他認為，Anthropic將努力推進IPO，因為公司確實需要這筆資金，尤其當私人市場融資可能變得更加困難時，上市將成為重要的資金來源。
根據《華爾街日報》報導，Anthropic的招股說明書草案顯示，公司未來數年在AI算力方面的支出可能高達7,500億美元。
此外，草案顯示，Anthropic在2026年上半年錄得逾800億美元淨虧損，營收則為163億美元。報導指出，這筆虧損主要來自會計調整，而非基本業務狀況惡化。
paras_en: AI startup Anthropic is reported to plan completing its initial public offering (IPO) in mid‑November, targeting a valuation of up to $2 trillion, which could make it one of the largest tech IPOs ever. However, recent selling pressure on AI‑related stocks and the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission’s (SEC) timing requirements for filing prospectuses are putting pressure on Anthropic’s listing schedule.

According to Reuters, regulations require a company to publicly file its S‑1 registration statement at least 15 days before the start of the road‑show. That leaves Anthropic very little time to prepare if it wants to stick to the original timetable.
If Anthropic lists at a $2 trillion valuation, its size would surpass SpaceX (SPCX‑US), which earlier this year went public at $1.77 trillion.

At the same time, market doubts about whether AI‑industry spending can be sustained are rising. Emerging cloud‑computing firm CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) has seen its share price fall about 30% over two weeks, and memory‑chip giant Micron Technology (MU‑US) has dropped 17% in the past month.
Market participants think this pull‑back could affect Anthropic’s IPO decision, but the company’s need for capital may also push it to continue with the offering plan.
Current market forecasts estimate roughly an 80% chance that Anthropic will go public before the end of the year.

Jay Ritter, head of the University of Florida’s IPO research project, said that if Anthropic wants to complete the listing before Thanksgiving, there is still time, but the schedule is extremely tight.
If the company sets the latest IPO date for November 24 and starts the road‑show on November 16, it must file the S‑1 publicly by the weekend before next week.
Anthropic had originally been expected to file its prospectus shortly after U.S. Labor Day, and the market at that time briefly expected a late‑September listing, but that timeline was not met.
AI stocks are being sold off, and market worries about spending and financing outlooks are key considerations for Anthropic’s management, according to MarketWatch.

Because the market is concerned about CoreWeave’s debt‑management ability, its shares have fallen about 30% in two weeks; Micron’s one‑month decline of 17% reflects rising investor anxiety over AI spending levels and financing prospects.
Joe Tigay, portfolio manager of the Rational Equity Armor Fund, also noted that persistent inflation pressure and high energy prices are cause for concern.

He believes that historically, a slowdown in economic growth combined with inflation often precedes stock‑market trouble. If those pressures continue to build, Anthropic may choose to postpone its listing and stay private until conditions improve.
However, some market participants argue that a successful Anthropic IPO would help revive investor confidence in the AI sector.

Jim Lebenthal, chief market strategist at Cerity Partners, said that recent doubts about the AI industry’s long‑term potential and business models mean a successful Anthropic IPO is needed to prove the sector’s ability to sustain growth.
He added that questioning and even skepticism about the industry are understandable, but the health of U.S. equities and the broader economy largely depends on whether AI can succeed.
Massive AI compute spending and funding needs are driving forces behind the IPO push, analysts note, alongside market conditions.
Andrew Rocco, stock strategist at Zacks Investment Research, said large AI firms have shown a willingness to invest heavily to attract users and aim for market leadership.
He believes Anthropic will push ahead with the IPO because it truly needs the capital, especially as private‑market financing may become harder, making the public market an important source of funds.
A draft of Anthropic’s prospectus, reported by the Wall Street Journal, shows the company could spend as much as $750 billion on AI compute over the next several years.

The draft also shows Anthropic recorded a net loss of over $80 billion in the first half of 2026, with revenue of $16.3 billion. The report notes the loss is mainly due to accounting adjustments rather than a deterioration of core business conditions.

items.title: 為川金會暖身？金正恩再訪中國 時機引關注
items.title_en: Warming Up for Trump? Kim Jong Un Returns to China, Timing Draws Attention
paras: 北韓最高領導人金正恩已抵達中國丹東，這是他一年多來第二度訪中，時間點落在美國總統川普下月前往亞洲之前。
一名南韓政府官員表示，金正恩似乎是經由新鴨綠江大橋抵達丹東。這座橋是過去一個月內啟用的兩座主要橋梁之一，兩座橋分別連接北韓與其重要貿易夥伴中國及俄羅斯。
金正恩曾於2025年9月前往北京出席大型閱兵典禮，中國國家主席習近平則於同年6月訪問北韓。這兩個傳統盟邦近來積極深化雙邊關係，包括恢復首都之間的鐵路與航班服務。
川普先前曾表達今年與金正恩會面的意願，但隨後降溫了外界對雙邊峰會的預期。川普原先計畫於11月前往中國深圳出席亞太經濟合作會議（APEC）峰會期間，為雙方舉行面會開啟大門。
國際危機組織資深顧問格林（Christopher Green）表示：「金正恩可能是為了在同意與川普會面前，先與習近平協調立場，這符合2018至2019年的先例。不過，除了對美外交，金正恩與中國還有許多議題可談，未來一兩天，議程應會逐漸明朗。」
共同社報導，金正恩此行可能包括出席中國在韓戰期間出兵援助北韓的76週年紀念活動。
paras_en: North Korea’s supreme leader Kim Jong Un has arrived in Dandong, China, marking his second visit to the country in just over a year, and coming just before U.S. President Trump’s scheduled trip to Asia next month.

A South Korean government official said Kim appears to have entered Dandong via the New Yalu River Bridge. The bridge is one of two major crossings that were opened in the past month, linking North Korea with its key trading partners China and Russia.

Kim previously traveled to Beijing in September 2025 to attend a large military parade, while Chinese President Xi Jinping visited North Korea in June of the same year. The two traditional allies have recently been deepening bilateral ties, including restoring rail and flight services between their capitals.

Trump had earlier expressed a willingness to meet Kim this year, but that softened expectations for a bilateral summit. Trump originally planned to travel to Shenzhen, China, in November for the APEC summit and to use the occasion for a face‑to‑face meeting.

Christopher Green, a senior adviser at the International Crisis Group, said, “Kim may be coordinating his stance with Xi before agreeing to meet Trump, following the precedent set in 2018‑2019. However, beyond U.S. diplomacy, Kim has many issues to discuss with China, and the agenda should become clearer over the next day or two.”
According to Kyodo News, Kim’s trip may also include attending the 76th‑anniversary commemoration of China’s military assistance to North Korea during the Korean War.

items.title: Meta探索AI變現新路：Muse不放廣告、購物抽成與企業服務收費
items.title_en: Meta Explores New AI Monetization Paths: Muse Free of Ads, Shopping Commissions, and Enterprise Service Fees
paras: Meta(META-US) 正為人工智慧（AI）業務開拓廣告以外的收入來源。Meta首席AI長Alexandr Wang表示，個人AI代理Muse將維持免廣告，一般用戶可免費使用，高階功能則採訂閱制，並規劃推出企業付費服務，以及從AI代理促成的購物交易中收取佣金。
Wang接受《日經新聞》訪問時指出，Muse不僅能回答問題，還能代替使用者執行任務，協助節省時間與金錢，因此比先前的AI產品更實用。
Muse於9月8日在北美上線，六週內應用程式下載量達到1,000萬次，成長速度超越包括ChatGPT在內的部分競爭產品，並於10月23日首度進軍日本市場。
免費吸引用戶 高階功能採訂閱制
Meta希望未來將Muse推廣至數十億用戶，目前對一般使用者免費開放，並已針對重度用戶及希望使用最先進模型的用戶推出訂閱方案。此外，公司也計劃提供企業付費服務，但尚未揭露具體收費標準與推出時間。
與Meta旗下社群平台仰賴廣告的營運模式不同，Wang明確表示：「Muse內部沒有廣告，我們也沒有投放廣告的計畫。」這意味著，按照目前規劃，Meta不會直接在Muse的互動介面置入廣告。
對廣告收入占比超過95%的Meta而言，Muse提供了探索其他收入來源的機會。隨著產品拓展至更多市場，加上公司持續斥資建設AI基礎設施，如何將用戶成長轉化為可持續的收入，成為市場關注焦點。
AI代理協助購物 Meta規劃抽佣
除了個人訂閱與企業服務，Meta也計劃從用戶透過AI代理完成的購物交易中抽取佣金，讓Muse的應用從資訊查詢、任務協助延伸至購物。
這項模式可望為Meta帶來廣告以外的交易收入，但實際執行方式仍待釐清。公司尚未公布佣金比例、適用商家範圍與正式推出時間。
未來能創造多少收入，將取決於Muse執行任務的能力、商家串接情況，以及使用者是否願意將購物決策交給AI代理。
擴大基礎建設 支撐產品發展
Wang認為，Meta自有的技術基礎設施、安全體系與資料中心，是競爭對手難以複製的重要優勢。個人AI代理需要執行任務、處理使用者資訊並串接不同服務，除了模型能力，基礎設施的規模、可靠性與安全性也相當重要。
Meta週三(21日)於美股盤後公布財報時，將2026年資本支出預估區間調整為1,350億至1,450億美元，下限較先前提高50億美元。
公司22日提交的監管文件另顯示，截至9月底，尚未開始履行的租賃義務與不可撤銷合約承諾合計約8,100億美元。若納入最高約147億美元的或有雲端運算容量採購義務，未來承諾投入總額接近8,250億美元。
上述投入除支援Meta現有業務，也將用於新一代AI模型與產品開發。龐大的基礎建設能否提升產品能力，進而帶動訂閱、企業服務與交易佣金收入，將是Muse商業化進展的關鍵。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) is seeking revenue streams beyond advertising for its artificial intelligence (AI) business. Meta’s chief AI officer Alexandr Wang said the personal AI agent Muse will remain ad‑free, with general users able to use it for free, while premium features will be subscription‑based. The company also plans to launch paid enterprise services and to take a commission on shopping transactions facilitated by the AI agent.

In an interview with the Nikkei, Wang noted that Muse not only answers questions but can also perform tasks on behalf of users, helping them save time and money, making it more practical than previous AI products.

Muse launched in North America on September 8 and amassed 10 million app downloads within six weeks, growing faster than several competing products including ChatGPT, and entered the Japanese market for the first time on October 23.
Free to attract users, premium features subscription‑based

Meta hopes to eventually roll Muse out to billions of users. It is currently free for ordinary users, and a subscription plan has been introduced for heavy users and those who want access to the most advanced models. The company also plans to offer paid enterprise services, though it has not disclosed pricing or rollout timing.

Unlike Meta’s ad‑driven social platforms, Wang made it clear: “There are no ads inside Muse, and we have no plans to run ads.” This means that, under current plans, Meta will not place advertisements directly in Muse’s interaction interface.

For Meta, whose ad revenue accounts for more than 95% of its income, Muse offers an opportunity to explore other revenue sources. As the product expands into more markets and the company continues to invest heavily in AI infrastructure, the question of how to turn user growth into sustainable revenue has become a focal point for the market.
AI agent assists shopping, Meta plans commissions

In addition to personal subscriptions and enterprise services, Meta also plans to take a commission on shopping transactions completed by users through the AI agent, extending Muse’s use from information lookup and task assistance to commerce.

This model could generate transaction revenue for Meta beyond advertising, but the exact implementation details remain unclear. The company has not disclosed the commission rate, the range of applicable merchants, or the official launch date.

How much revenue it can eventually generate will depend on Muse’s task‑execution capabilities, merchant integration, and whether users are willing to entrust their purchasing decisions to an AI agent.
Expanding infrastructure to support product development

Wang believes Meta’s own technology infrastructure, security systems, and data centers constitute a significant advantage that rivals cannot easily replicate. A personal AI agent must execute tasks, process user data, and connect to various services; beyond model capability, the scale, reliability, and security of the underlying infrastructure are equally critical.

When Meta reported earnings after the U.S. market close on Wednesday (the 21st), it revised its 2026 capital‑expenditure outlook to a range of $135 billion to $145 billion, raising the lower end by $5 billion from its prior estimate.

Regulatory filings submitted on the 22nd show that as of the end of September, unfulfilled lease obligations and irrevocable contract commitments total about $810 billion. Including up to roughly $14.7 billion of potential cloud‑computing capacity purchase obligations, the total future commitment approaches $825 billion.

These investments will support Meta’s existing businesses as well as the development of next‑generation AI models and products. Whether the massive infrastructure boost can enhance product capabilities and drive subscription, enterprise service, and transaction‑commission revenue will be key to Muse’s commercialization progress.

items.title: 阿拉斯加LNG開發案遭爆獲俄國受制裁企業融資！Novatek涉入營運引發合規疑慮
items.title_en: Alaska LNG Project Faces Financing from Sanctioned Russian Firm; Novatek Involvement Raises Compliance Concerns
paras: 傳阿拉斯加液化天然氣（LNG）開發案涉及受美國制裁的俄羅斯能源巨頭Novatek PJSC，引發外界對制裁合規問題的關注。
根據《金融時報》報導，Polar Train LNG前執行長Joel Riddle指出，Novatek曾向Polar Train LNG的開發計畫提供資金，並在取得美國財政部必要許可前介入項目營運。
《金融時報》及《紐約時報》另一篇報導指出，Riddle上月辭職，隨後另有多名高階主管離任。
不過，Polar LNG周五（23日）發布聲明反駁，稱Riddle是「心懷不滿的前員工」，且已遭公司解雇。公司強調，開發工作均依照美國適用法律進行。
根據該聲明，Polar LNG已向美國財政部海外資產控制辦公室（OFAC）提出許可申請，尋求取得向Novatek購買一座尚未完工的重力式結構的許可。該結構是液化天然氣設施的一部分。
《金融時報》引述Novatek聲明指出，該公司已於今年4月與Polar Train簽署諒解備忘錄，並表示，要執行如此大規模的項目，仍須取得美國與俄羅斯主管機關的必要批准。
美國財政部官員則表示，該部門不會針對違反制裁規定的指控發表評論，但會「極其嚴肅地看待」任何潛在違規行為。
另一方面，Polar Train LNG的營運公司已任命前高盛俄羅斯銀行執行長Tim Talkington出任代理執行長。公司聲明指出，Talkington目前也是母公司Polar Eagle LNG的總裁。
Polar LNG的目標是在2030年底前，開始從阿拉斯加北坡輸送天然氣。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: It is reported that the Alaska liquefied natural gas (LNG) development project involves Russia’s energy giant Novatek PJSC, which is under U.S. sanctions, sparking concerns about sanctions compliance.

According to the Financial Times, former Polar Train LNG CEO Joel Riddle said Novatek had provided funding for Polar Train LNG’s development plan and entered the project’s operations before obtaining the necessary U.S. Treasury permission.
The Financial Times and another New York Times report noted that Riddle resigned last month, and several other senior executives have also left their positions.

However, Polar LNG issued a statement on Friday (the 23rd) denying the allegations, describing Riddle as a "disgruntled former employee" who had been terminated by the company, and emphasizing that the development work is being carried out in compliance with applicable U.S. law.

The statement said Polar LNG has applied to the U.S. Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) for a license to purchase an unfinished gravity‑based structure from Novatek, a component of the LNG facility.

The Financial Times quoted a Novatek statement indicating the company signed a memorandum of understanding with Polar Train in April of this year and said that executing a project of this scale still requires the necessary approvals from both U.S. and Russian regulators.
A U.S. Treasury official said the department would not comment on allegations of sanctions violations but would "take any potential breaches extremely seriously."

Meanwhile, Polar Train LNG’s operating company has appointed former Goldman Sachs Russia bank CEO Tim Talkington as interim CEO, and the company noted that Talkington is also president of its parent, Polar Eagle LNG.
Polar LNG aims to begin transporting natural gas from Alaska’s North Slope by the end of 2030.
(This article is not available for partner re‑publication)

items.title: 高盛示警：AI恐取代9%勞工！經濟若衰退恐加劇裁員
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Warns: AI Could Replace 9% of Workers; Recession Could Accelerate Layoffs
paras: 人工智慧(AI)對就業市場的影響前景不容樂觀，根據高盛(Goldman Sachs)最新預測，最多可能有9%勞工被迫離開目前的工作崗位，相當於約1500萬名勞工的工作受到AI衝擊。
高盛首席經濟學家Jan Hatzius去年曾預測，AI可能取代美國6%至7%的勞工，但根據高盛更新後的預測，勞工遭取代的比率可能達到9%。
高盛的基本情境假設美國及其他已開發經濟體的生產力提高15%。

AI衝擊就業恐逐步升溫 經濟衰退可能加速自動化

報告指出，AI的採用也可能因整體招聘放緩而對就業市場造成壓力。不過，AI對整體失業率的影響，可能更多來自實際工作職位遭到裁撤，而非企業減少招聘。
Hatzius說：「根據我們對明年經濟成長接近潛在成長率的基本預測，估算結果顯示，AI對勞動市場的衝擊可能只會逐步擴大，而不是突然對就業市場造成衝擊。」
高盛預估，美國的AI採用仍處於初期階段，目前將AI納入日常工作流程的企業不到四分之一。
Hatzius表示，如果美國經濟陷入衰退，AI的採用速度可能加快。他援引高盛對過去經濟衰退期間自動化發展周期的分析指出，景氣下滑可能促使企業加速導入自動化技術。
他寫道：「我們分析中更令人擔憂的結論是，景氣循環放緩可能加速與AI相關的自動化及裁員，進而放大整體景氣循環的波動。」

AI裁員仍是企業縮編主因 入門白領工作面臨威脅

市場對AI可能造成失業的恐慌已略為降溫，但部分研究人員仍擔心，AI未來可能大幅削減入門級白領工作。
美國企業9月宣布的裁員數有所下降，但AI仍是企業最常提及的裁員原因，占所有已宣布裁員人數的21%。
根據Challenger, Gray & Christmas的數據，科技業的裁員情況也比其他任何產業嚴重，9月占所有裁員人數的29%。
paras_en: The impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on the labor market looks bleak; according to Goldman Sachs' latest forecast, up to 9% of workers could be forced out of their current jobs, roughly 15 million workers affected by AI.
Goldman Sachs chief economist Jan Hatzius last year predicted that AI might replace 6% to 7% of U.S. workers, but the updated forecast puts the replacement rate at as high as 9%.
Goldman's baseline scenario assumes a 15% productivity increase in the United States and other developed economies.

AI's impact on employment could gradually intensify, and an economic recession may speed up automation. The report notes that AI adoption could also strain the labor market as overall hiring slows, but the effect on the overall unemployment rate is likely to come more from actual job cuts than from firms hiring less.

Hatzius said, "Based on our baseline projection that next year's economic growth will be close to potential growth, the estimate shows that AI's impact on the labor market will likely expand gradually rather than shock the job market suddenly."
Goldman estimates that AI adoption in the United States is still in its early stage, with fewer than a quarter of firms currently integrating AI into daily workflows.

Hatzius added that if the U.S. economy falls into a recession, the pace of AI adoption could accelerate. He cited Goldman’s analysis of automation cycles during past downturns, noting that a slowdown in activity may prompt firms to speed up the deployment of automation technologies.
He wrote, "A more concerning conclusion from our analysis is that a slowdown in the business cycle could hasten AI‑related automation and layoffs, thereby amplifying overall economic volatility."

AI-driven layoffs remain a primary reason for corporate downsizing, putting entry‑level white‑collar jobs at risk. While market panic over AI‑induced unemployment has eased somewhat, some researchers still worry that AI could sharply cut entry‑level white‑collar positions in the future.
U.S. companies reported a slight decline in announced layoffs in September, but AI remained the most frequently cited reason for cuts, accounting for 21% of all announced layoffs.
According to data from Challenger, Gray & Christmas, the tech sector experienced the most severe layoffs of any industry, representing 29% of all layoffs in September.

items.title: 散戶抄底半導體股慘套牢！SOXL單周吸金61億美元、10月暴跌逾43%
items.title_en: Retail Investors Trapped in Bottom‑Buying Semiconductor Stocks! SOXL Draws $6.1 B in a Week, Falls Over 43% in October
paras: 美股半導體股跌勢加劇，押注反彈的散戶投資人反而面臨更大損失。FactSet數據顯示，追蹤半導體指數每日報酬3倍的槓桿型ETF Direxion 每日3倍看多半導體ETF(SOXL-US) 上周單周吸引創紀錄的61億美元資金流入，但晶片股不僅未如預期反彈，跌勢反而進一步擴大，讓進場抄底的資金迅速陷入虧損。
根據FactSet數據，SOXL上周單周流入61億美元，創下歷史新高。這檔ETF旨在提供半導體指數每日漲跌幅的3倍報酬，屬於風險較高的槓桿投資工具。
資金大舉湧入之際，半導體股已經歷一波下跌，市場對AI交易的熱情也開始降溫。部分投資人押注，股價跌幅愈大，短期反彈的機會就愈高。
然而，資金流入持續至周四，SOXL當天卻暴跌20.5%，創6月23日以來最大單日跌幅。SOXL本周再跌10.8%，連續第3周收黑，10月以來累計跌幅已超過43%。
相較之下，非槓桿型的安碩半導體ETF(SOXX-US) 當日下跌6.8%，跌幅明顯較小。
市場賣壓主要來自投資人對人工智慧（AI）投資回報的疑慮。隨著科技巨頭持續大舉投入AI基礎設施，市場開始重新檢視相關支出能否轉化為足夠的獲利，半導體股也因此承受估值壓力。
與此同時，美股三大指數周五（23日）全數收跌，標普500資訊科技類股更連續3周下跌，寫下自3月以來最長連跌紀錄。
受惠於AI晶片需求快速成長，半導體股今年以來曾大幅上漲，安碩半導體ETF年內一度飆升近59%。不過，隨著市場開始檢視AI基礎設施投資的實際回報，半導體股原有的漲勢正面臨挑戰。
財富管理公司Glenmede投資策略副總裁Mike Reynolds指出，半導體產業與AI基礎設施建設高度相關，目前市場對AI投資題材已出現一定程度的質疑。
他也認為，在股價經歷強勁上漲、估值大幅攀升後，投資人重新評估AI題材的潛在回報，屬於健康的市場現象。
Reynolds表示，與其等到市場熱潮完全脫離基本面後才提出疑問，投資人及早檢視相關投資的合理性，反而有助於市場調整。
分析指出，SOXL的表現再次凸顯槓桿ETF的風險。這類產品透過衍生性金融商品放大每日報酬，在市場上漲時可能帶來較高收益，但當行情走勢與投資方向相反時，損失也會迅速擴大。
10月以來，SOXL累計下跌逾43%，同期SOXX跌幅約15.9%，兩者差距反映3倍槓桿在下跌行情中的放大效果。
半導體股本月的劇烈波動，也多次影響標普500指數的單日表現，顯示AI投資情緒已成為牽動美股的重要因素。
對押注短期反彈的投資人而言，這波行情不僅是方向判斷失準，更凸顯槓桿產品的風險：當市場持續下跌，原本期待放大獲利的工具，也可能迅速放大虧損。
paras_en: The decline in U.S. semiconductor stocks has intensified, leaving retail investors who bet on a rebound facing even greater losses. FactSet data shows that the leveraged ETF tracking the semiconductor index at three times daily returns, Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X Shares (SOXL‑US), attracted a record $6.1 billion of inflows last week, yet chip stocks not only failed to rebound as expected but instead fell further, quickly turning the bottom‑buying capital into losses.

According to FactSet, SOXL drew $6.1 billion last week, setting a new historical high. This ETF aims to deliver three times the daily performance of the semiconductor index and is a high‑risk leveraged investment vehicle.

When the capital surged in, semiconductor stocks had already been on a downward trend, and enthusiasm for AI trading was cooling. Some investors bet that the larger the price decline, the higher the chance of a short‑term rebound.

However, the inflow continued until Thursday, when SOXL plunged 20.5% that day, its largest single‑day drop since June 23. SOXL fell 10.8% this week, marking its third consecutive week of losses, and its cumulative decline since October has exceeded 43%.
In contrast, the non‑leveraged iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX‑US) fell 6.8% that day, a noticeably smaller decline.

Market selling pressure mainly stemmed from investors’ doubts about the returns of AI investments. As tech giants continue to pour large sums into AI infrastructure, the market has begun to reassess whether such spending can translate into sufficient profits, putting valuation pressure on semiconductor stocks.

Meanwhile, all three U.S. major indices fell on Friday (23rd), and the S&P 500 Information Technology sector dropped for the third consecutive week, marking the longest streak of declines since March.

Benefiting from rapid growth in AI chip demand, semiconductor stocks have surged this year, with the iShares Semiconductor ETF soaring nearly 59% year‑to‑date. However, as the market starts to scrutinize the actual returns of AI infrastructure investments, the previous upward momentum of semiconductor stocks is facing challenges.

Mike Reynolds, Vice President of Investment Strategies at wealth‑management firm Glenmede, noted that the semiconductor industry is highly correlated with AI infrastructure construction, and that the market has begun to question the AI investment theme to some extent.
He also believes that after a strong rally and a significant rise in valuations, investors reassessing the potential returns of AI themes is a healthy market phenomenon.

Reynolds said that rather than waiting for the market hype to completely detach from fundamentals before raising questions, early scrutiny of the rationality of such investments actually helps the market adjust.

Analysis points out that SOXL’s performance again highlights the risks of leveraged ETFs. These products amplify daily returns through derivatives; they can yield higher gains when markets rise, but when the trend moves against the investment direction, losses can expand rapidly.
Since October, SOXL has fallen over 43% cumulatively, while SOXX has declined about 15.9% in the same period, reflecting the magnified effect of three‑times leverage in a downtrend.
The sharp volatility of semiconductor stocks this month has repeatedly impacted the daily performance of the S&P 500, showing that AI investment sentiment has become a key driver of U.S. equities.

For investors betting on a short‑term rebound, this market move not only reflects a misjudgment of direction but also underscores the risk of leveraged products: when the market continues to fall, tools that were expected to amplify gains can quickly amplify losses.

items.title: 今年來台股基金最旺冠居亞股 中小、科技績效近翻倍
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Funds Lead Asia This Year, Small‑Cap and Tech Performance Nearly Doubles
paras: 今年來，全球主要股票市場頻頻創新高，也讓股票基金績效長紅。統計今年來全球主要股市漲幅排名，整體來看，亞股表現最佳，其中以台灣加權股價指數漲幅居冠，韓國居亞軍、日本名列第三。市場法人表示，台股行情要持續發熱，最需要中小型股續航，建議投資人可以中小型、科技台股基金來介入。
群益投信台股研究團隊表示，台灣經濟成長性與各產業展望都有投資機會，台股自然也是投資人成長投資必要選項，台股長期趨勢往上不變，台股行情要持續發熱，最需要中小型股續航，不過中小型個股的震盪加劇，表現差異相當大，基金投資的低波動優勢勝過個股，建議投資人可以中小型台股基金來介入。另外科技半導體也是台灣最具競爭力的產業，科技基金更是不可或缺的投資標的。
群益中小型股基金經理人周立民表示，現階段台股呈現高檔換手與資金重新布局。尤其AI概念股仍是市場主軸，只是從過去全面齊漲，轉為「輪動加速、個股分化」。
儘管台股市場近期呈現高檔震盪，然而長期供不應求的產業仍受到市場關注，包含載板、被動元件、PCB/CCL等。此外，隨著ASIC和GPU新產品的效能將再度提升，也將帶動高階技術的發展，包含測試介面、先進製程、光通訊等也將會關注重點。
群益創新科技暨主動群益科技創新ETF(00992A-TW)基金經理人陳朝政表示，隨著AI商機不斷擴大，AI需求也轉變成長期、結構性需求，預期台股企業從上游晶片半導體廠商到下流零組件及組裝營運都將迎來高成長。
在投資布局方面，可聚焦基本面穩健、具護城河優勢的產業龍頭，掌握AI長期成長動能，並持續關注AI技術迭代週期，提前卡位題材短線爆發契機。持續看好半導體先進製程、半導體設備、通訊等族群，AI應用以及提高生產力族群亦看好。

paras_en: This year, major global equity markets have repeatedly hit new highs, boosting the performance of equity funds. Ranking the year‑to‑date gains of major world stock indices, Asian markets performed best overall, with Taiwan's weighted index posting the top gain, followed by South Korea and Japan. Market analysts say the Taiwan market will keep heating up and that sustained momentum in small‑cap stocks is essential, recommending investors consider small‑cap and technology Taiwan equity funds for exposure.

The research team at Quannyi Investment Trust says Taiwan’s economic growth prospects and industry outlook offer investment opportunities, making Taiwan equities a necessary component of growth‑oriented portfolios. The long‑term upward trend of the Taiwan market remains unchanged, and continued market heat will rely on small‑cap stocks, though volatility among these stocks has intensified and performance varies widely. The lower‑volatility advantage of funds over individual stocks makes small‑cap Taiwan equity funds a good entry point. In addition, the semiconductor and technology sectors are Taiwan’s most competitive industries, making tech funds indispensable.

Fund manager Zhou Limin of Quannyi’s small‑cap equity fund notes that the Taiwan market is currently experiencing high‑level turnover and a reallocation of capital. AI‑related stocks remain the market’s core theme, but the rally has shifted from a broad, uniform rise to faster rotation and greater divergence among individual stocks.

Despite recent high‑level fluctuations in the Taiwan market, long‑term supply‑constrained industries continue to attract attention, including substrates, passive components, and PCB/CCL. Moreover, as new ASIC and GPU products deliver higher performance, they will drive advanced technology development in areas such as test interfaces, advanced processes, and optical communications.

ETF manager Chen Chao‑zheng of Quannyi Innovation Technology and Active Quannyi Technology Innovation ETF (00992A‑TW) says that as AI business opportunities expand, AI demand is turning into a long‑term, structural need. He expects Taiwan companies—from upstream chip manufacturers to downstream components and assembly operations—to experience strong growth.

For investment positioning, focus on fundamentally sound, moat‑protected industry leaders that can capture the long‑term AI growth engine, and keep an eye on AI technology iteration cycles to get ahead of short‑term thematic breakouts. He remains bullish on advanced semiconductor processes, semiconductor equipment, communications, AI applications, and productivity‑enhancing sectors.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉安克生醫安克呼止偵獲美國聯邦醫療保險支付 周漲近2成
items.title_en: <Hot Stock> Anke Biotech’s Anke Respiration Detector Secures Medicare Reimbursement, Stock Rises Nearly 20% in a Week
paras: 安克生醫(4188-TW)旗下安克呼止偵於美國史丹佛睡眠醫學中心成功獲得聯邦醫療保險(Medicare)支付檢測費用，並持續拓展海外市場，激勵安克生醫股價漲勢凌厲，單周大漲近2成。
安克生醫本周漲19.1%，周四(22日)亮燈漲停，收17.15元，站上所有均線。三大法人也連續3個交易日買超，本周合計買超227張。
安克呼止偵以非侵入式超音波結合AI分析，10分鐘可完成阻塞型睡眠呼吸中止症(OSA)風險篩檢。自2019年起合作的美國史丹佛睡眠醫學中心，已逐步將產品導入臨床流程，應用從篩檢延伸至治療評估與轉介，並透過既有醫療處置代碼，成功獲得美國聯邦醫療保險(Medicare)支付檢測費用，為拓展美國市場建立重要實例。
另外，安克呼止偵也已完成土耳其設備出貨及臨床導入，杜拜據點持續生成應用，並洽談英國市場合作，推進設備銷售與軟體訂閱服務。
安克甲狀偵方面，已獲全台超過30家醫療院所採用，預計第四季向相關專家提出健保暫時性支付HTR計畫，推進後續收集真實世界數據。國際上，安克與 CARPL、deepc及SECTRA等醫療影像平台推動技術整合與合作洽談，期望透過平台的醫院網絡，加速產品拓展海外市場。
paras_en: Anke Biotech (4188‑TW) announced that its Anke Respiration Detector has successfully obtained Medicare reimbursement for testing fees at Stanford Sleep Medicine Center in the United States, and the company continues to expand overseas markets, driving a sharp rise in Anke Biotech’s share price, which jumped almost 20% in a single week.

The stock rose 19.1% this week; on Thursday (the 22nd) it hit the daily limit up, closing at NT$17.15 and moving above all moving averages. The three major institutional investors bought net shares for three consecutive trading days, totaling a net purchase of 227 lots this week.

The Anke Respiration Detector uses non‑invasive ultrasound combined with AI analysis to complete a 10‑minute screening for obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) risk. Since 2019, the Stanford Sleep Medicine Center in the United States has gradually integrated the product into clinical workflows, extending its use from screening to treatment assessment and referral, and by leveraging existing medical procedure codes, it has successfully secured Medicare reimbursement for the test, providing a key case for expanding into the U.S. market.

In addition, the Anke Respiration Detector has completed equipment shipments and clinical rollout in Turkey, its Dubai hub continues to generate applications, and talks are underway for cooperation in the United Kingdom to advance equipment sales and software subscription services.

Regarding Anke’s thyroid detector, it has already been adopted by more than 30 medical institutions across Taiwan, and a temporary National Health Insurance reimbursement (HTR) plan is expected to be submitted to relevant experts in Q4 to facilitate further real‑world data collection. Internationally, Anke is pursuing technology integration and cooperation with medical imaging platforms such as CARPL, deepc and SECTRA, hoping to accelerate overseas product expansion through the platforms’ hospital networks.

items.title: 美光罷工危機解除、外銷訂單連20紅、公股投信四合一拍板 本周大事回顧
items.title_en: Micron Strike Crisis Resolved, Export Orders Rise for 20 Consecutive Months, State-Owned Asset Managers Approve Four‑Way Merger – Weekly Highlights
paras: 美光台中工會與公司達成勞資協議，罷工危機解除；經濟部周二(20日)公布9月外銷統計，受惠AI需求強勁，9月外銷訂單金額達1142.1億美元，創歷史單月新高，連20紅；第一金控、兆豐金控、合庫金控與華南金控等4家公股金控董事會及旗下投信子公司第一金投信、兆豐國際投信、合作金庫投信及華南永昌投信等四家董事會，分別於周四(22日)通過4家投信子公司整併案，以下為本周大事回顧：

美光台中工會協商成功！8成人員調薪近2.7倍 經部盼桃園廠跟進 

美光(MICR-US)台中工會與公司達成勞資協議，約8成以上人員調薪近2.7倍，產線人員年薪提高至200多萬元，初階與中高階工程師年薪更分別上看400萬與600萬元，勞退提撥亦升至10%。經濟部周四(22日)晚間表示樂見雙方達成共識，並期盼桃園廠能持續溝通，共同創造雙贏。

〈外銷訂單〉連20紅！9月1142億美元年增62% 全年可望破兆美元 

經濟部周二(20日)公布9月外銷訂單統計，受惠於AI、高效能運算及雲端服務需求持續強勁，加上消費性電子新品陸續上市帶動拉貨動能，9月外銷訂單金額高達1,142.1億美元，創歷史單月新高，較上月大幅增加112.5億美元或10.9%，與去年同月相比更爆增438.7億美元，年增率攀升至62.4%。8、9月更是連續2個月衝破千億美元大關，刷新連續20個月正成長紀錄。

四大公股投信整併案拍板！第一金控持股50.3% 第一金投信存續 

第一金控(2892-TW)、兆豐金控(2886-TW)、合庫金控(5880-TW)及華南金控(2880-TW)等四家公股金控董事會及旗下投信子公司第一金投信、兆豐國際投信、合作金庫投信及華南永昌投信等四家董事會，分別於周四(22日)通過四家投信子公司整併案，本整併案由資產管理規模最大、經營績效較佳的第一金投信擔任存續公司。

〈財委會質詢〉台股巨震步入熊市？彭金隆：尊重市場機制 暫無限空令等措施 

近期台股波動加劇，引發市場對「熊市」的擔憂，周一(19日)立法院財政委員會高度關注政府監理工具與當沖降稅政策。金管會主委彭金隆強調，監理機關首重尊重市場機制，目前交易秩序仍屬理性，暫無實施限空或禁空等人工干預措施；針對 2027 年底到期的當沖降稅優惠，金管會規劃於明年 2、3 月召開公聽會廣徵各界意見，再行定奪。

〈力積電法說〉Q4營收估季增雙位數 明年成熟製程代工價格再漲10-20% 

力積電(6770-TW)周三(21)日召開法說，經營團隊表示，受惠記憶體供需持續吃緊、邏輯晶圓代工價格調漲，以及3D AI Foundry相關產品逐步恢復出貨，預期第四季營收可望季增雙位數；明年在AI需求動能不減下，對營收及獲利表現抱持期待，成熟製程代工價格規劃再調漲10%至20%，並積極與客戶協商長期供貨合約(LTA)，提前綁定明年價量。

是方中科虎尾AI資料中心挑戰預約率8至9成 目標2031年獲利 

是方(6561-TW)中科虎尾AI資料中心周二(20日)舉辦動土典禮，總經理劉耀元指出，是方中科虎尾AI資料中心將於2028年下半年啟用商轉，挑戰預約率達8至9成，目標在2031年開始獲利。
paras_en: Micron's Taichung union and the company reached a labor agreement, ending the strike crisis; the Ministry of Economic Affairs on Tuesday (the 20th) released September export statistics, showing that strong AI demand lifted September export order value to $114.21 billion, a historic monthly high and the 20th consecutive month of growth; the boards of four state‑owned financial holding companies – First Financial Holding, Mega Financial Holding, Cooperative Financial Holding and Hua Nan Financial Holding – and their respective asset‑management subsidiaries – First Financial Asset Management, Mega International Asset Management, Cooperative Bank Asset Management and Hua Nan Yongchang Asset Management – each approved the merger of the four asset‑management units on Thursday (the 22nd). This is the weekly recap of major events.

Micron (MICR‑US) Taichung union successfully negotiated! About 80% of staff received salary hikes of roughly 2.7 times, raising line workers' annual pay to over NT$2 million, while junior and senior engineers now earn about NT$4 million and NT$6 million respectively; retirement contributions were also increased to 10%. The Ministry of Economic Affairs said on Thursday evening that it welcomed the consensus and hopes the Taoyuan plant will continue talks to create a win‑win outcome.

Export orders posted a 20‑month winning streak! September’s $114.21 billion in orders represented a 62% year‑over‑year increase and is expected to push total 2024 exports past the trillion‑dollar mark. The surge was driven by robust AI, high‑performance computing and cloud‑service demand, plus new consumer‑electronics launches that boosted shipments. September’s figure was up $11.25 billion (10.9%) from August and $43.87 billion (62.4%) higher than the same month last year, marking the second consecutive month above $100 billion and extending a 20‑month growth streak.

Four state‑owned asset‑management merger approved! First Financial Holding (2892‑TW) will hold a 50.3% stake and First Financial Asset Management will continue as the surviving entity. The boards of First Financial Holding, Mega Financial Holding (2886‑TW), Cooperative Financial Holding (5880‑TW) and Hua Nan Financial Holding (2880‑TW), together with their asset‑management subsidiaries, voted on Thursday (the 22nd) to merge the four units, with the largest and best‑performing First Financial Asset Management designated as the surviving company.

Financial Committee questioning: Is Taiwan’s stock market entering a bear market? Peng Jin‑long says respect market mechanisms, no short‑selling bans for now. Recent heightened volatility in Taiwan’s stock market has sparked bear‑market concerns. On Monday (the 19th), the Legislative Yuan’s Finance Committee closely examined government supervisory tools and the day‑trading tax‑reduction policy. Financial Supervisory Commission Chairman Peng Jin‑long emphasized that regulators must respect market mechanisms; trading remains orderly and there are no plans to impose short‑selling limits or bans. Regarding the day‑trading tax‑reduction incentive that expires at the end of 2027, the FSC will hold public hearings in February‑March next year to gather opinions before deciding.

Powerchip (6770‑TW) Q4 earnings forecast: double‑digit quarterly growth; mature‑process foundry prices to rise another 10‑20% next year. At its Wednesday (the 21st) earnings briefing, management said tight memory supply‑demand, higher logic‑wafer foundry prices and the gradual recovery of 3D AI Foundry product shipments should drive double‑digit quarterly revenue growth in Q4. Looking ahead to next year, with AI demand remaining strong, the company expects continued revenue and profit upside and plans a further 10%‑20% price increase for mature‑process foundry services, while actively negotiating long‑term supply agreements (LTA) to lock in volume and pricing.

IsFong (6561‑TW) launches groundbreaking ceremony for its Zhongke Huwei AI data center. General manager Liu Yao‑yuan said the facility, slated for commercial operation in the second half of 2028, aims for an 80%‑90% reservation rate and targets profitability starting in 2031.

items.title: 鴻海斥12.03億美元 增資新加坡、法國及捷克子公司
items.title_en: Foxconn Spends $1.203 Billion to Capital‑Increase Singapore, France and Czech Subsidiaries
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今(23)日公告，董事會通過對新加坡、法國及捷克子公司進行增資，交易金額分別為11.01億美元、5,800萬美元及4,400萬美元，合計斥資12.03億美元，作為長期投資用途。
鴻海公告指出，將對新加坡子公司eCMMS Precision Singapore Pte. Ltd.進行現金增資，認購普通股11.01億股，每股價格1美元，交易總金額11.01億美元。增資後，鴻海累計持有該公司19.13億股，持股比例達100%。
此外，鴻海也將對法國子公司Foxconn AI Solution (FR) SAS增資5,800萬美元，取得約510.07萬股，每股價格10歐元。增資後，鴻海累計持股數為510.07萬股，持股比例達100%。
在捷克方面，鴻海將對子公司Foxconn European Manufacturing Services s.r.o.增資4,400萬美元，約當9.44億捷克克朗。公告顯示，鴻海累計持有該公司股權金額為9.44億捷克克朗，持股比例90.42%；另由Foxconn Holdings B.V.持有1億捷克克朗，持股比例9.58%。
鴻海表示，上述三筆投資均以長期投資為目的，相關增資案均經董事會決議通過。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) announced today (23) that its board approved capital increases for subsidiaries in Singapore, France and the Czech Republic, with transaction amounts of $1.101 billion, $58 million and $44 million respectively, totaling $1.203 billion, for long‑term investment purposes.

Foxconn said it will make a cash capital increase in its Singapore subsidiary eCMMS Precision Singapore Pte. Ltd., subscribing for 1.101 billion ordinary shares at $1 per share, for a total of $1.101 billion. After the increase, Foxconn will hold a cumulative 1.913 billion shares, representing 100% ownership.

In addition, Foxconn will increase capital in its French subsidiary Foxconn AI Solution (FR) SAS by $58 million, acquiring about 5.1007 million shares at €10 per share. After the increase, Foxconn’s cumulative holding will be 5.1007 million shares, representing 100% ownership.

In the Czech Republic, Foxconn will increase capital in its subsidiary Foxconn European Manufacturing Services s.r.o. by $44 million, equivalent to CZK 944 million. The announcement shows Foxconn’s cumulative equity in the company is CZK 944 million, representing a 90.42% stake; Foxconn Holdings B.V. holds CZK 100 million, a 9.58% stake.
Foxconn said all three investments are for long‑term purposes and the capital increase plans have been approved by the board.

items.title: 〈工業生產指數〉連31紅！工業與製造業生產指數雙創新高 估10月續紅
items.title_en: Industrial Production Index Extends 31-Month Growth Streak; Both Industrial and Manufacturing Indices Hit Record Highs, October Expected to Remain Positive
paras: 受惠於人工智慧（AI）、高效能運算及雲端資料服務等應用需求持續熱絡，加上消費性電子新品備貨潮挹注，經濟部於今（23）日公布最新統計數據，9月工業生產指數為 140.76，較上年同月增加 19.17%；其中製造業生產指數達 143.31，年增 20.21%。兩大指數皆創下歷年同月新高，雙雙寫下連續 31 個月正成長紀錄。 展望10月，在AI與年終旺季帶動下，估 10 月製造業生產指數 141.56 至 145.86，年增 20.5% 至年增 24.2%。
累計今年前 9 個月來看，工業生產指數為 133.10，較上年同期增加 20.53%；製造業生產指數則為 135.48，年增 21.83%，展現出台灣科技製造業強韌的成長動能。
深入分析各產業表現，資訊電子工業成為推升本月指數創高的絕對主力，年增率高達 27.42%。其中：
電子零組件業： 9月年增 23.62%，主因受惠高效能運算與 AI 應用需求維持強勁，伴隨消費性電子新品備貨，帶動 12 吋晶圓代工、IC 封測、記憶體、IC 設計及載板等產品生產成長，累計前 9 月較上年同期增加 21.07%。
電腦電子產品及光學製品業： 隨著 AI 應用與雲端服務蓬勃發展，促使全球雲端服務大廠加速布建 AI 基礎設施，加以半導體設備投資動能續強，推升伺服器、半導體檢測設備及零組件、交換器、固態硬碟等產品生產大幅成長，年增率高達 45.92%，累計前 9 月更大增 80.05%。
在傳統產業方面，受惠於半導體業者持續擴產以及 AI 供應鏈的外溢需求，部分產業同步展現增產態勢：
機械設備業： 年增 26.02%，主因半導體廠持續拓展先進製程與高階封測產能，帶動電子與半導體生產用設備及零組件、機械傳動設備等產量擴增，外加工具機訂單續增所致。
基本金屬業與汽車零組件業： 基本金屬業年增 1.39%，主因市場需求緩步回溫，熱軋鋼捲板與靶材等產品生產增加；汽車及其零件業則因市場需求增溫及電動車政策加持，年增 2.35%。
化學材料及肥料業： 則因部分產品市場回溫力道仍緩，年減 4.29%（惟拋光矽晶圓受惠半導體需求持續增產）。

展望未來，經濟部指出，雖然全球經濟成長動能仍受到地緣政治及貿易政策等不確定性因素影響，但受惠於 AI、高效能運算及雲端服務等新興科技應用需求持續擴增，全球雲端大廠積極投資 AI 基礎設施，將有助於延續我國半導體先進製程、高階封裝及伺服器等相關供應鏈的生產動能。再加上年終消費旺季的備貨需求陸續湧現，預期將可有效支撐我國製造業生產維持穩健成長態勢。綜合研判，估 10 月製造業生產指數 141.56 至 145.86，年增 20.5% 至年增 24.2%。
paras_en: Benefiting from sustained demand for artificial intelligence (AI), high‑performance computing and cloud data services, as well as a surge in inventory buildup for new consumer electronics, the Ministry of Economic Affairs released the latest statistics on the 23rd. September’s industrial production index was 140.76, up 19.17% year‑on‑year; the manufacturing production index reached 143.31, up 20.21% YoY. Both indices set new monthly records and marked the 31st consecutive month of growth. Looking ahead to October, driven by AI and the year‑end peak season, the manufacturing production index is projected to range from 141.56 to 145.86, representing a 20.5% to 24.2% annual increase.

Cumulatively for the first nine months of this year, the industrial production index stood at 133.10, 20.53% higher than the same period last year; the manufacturing production index was 135.48, up 21.83% YoY, showcasing the robust growth momentum of Taiwan’s technology manufacturing sector.
A detailed sector analysis shows that the information and electronics industry was the absolute driver behind this month’s record‑high index, posting a year‑over‑year growth of 27.42%.

Electronic components: In September, the sector grew 23.62% YoY, mainly due to strong demand from high‑performance computing and AI applications, coupled with inventory buildup for new consumer electronics, which boosted production of 12‑inch wafer foundry, IC packaging and testing, memory, IC design and substrates, resulting in a 21.07% increase for the first nine months compared with last year.

Computer electronic products and optical products: The booming development of AI applications and cloud services has prompted global cloud providers to accelerate the deployment of AI infrastructure, further strengthening semiconductor equipment investment. This drove substantial production growth in servers, semiconductor testing equipment and components, switches, solid‑state drives and other products, with a 45.92% YoY increase and an 80.05% rise for the first nine months.
In traditional industries, the continued expansion of semiconductor manufacturers and spill‑over demand from the AI supply chain have led several sectors to show production gains as well.

Machinery and equipment: The sector grew 26.02% YoY, driven by semiconductor firms expanding advanced processes and high‑end packaging capacity, which increased demand for equipment and components used in electronics and semiconductor production, as well as mechanical transmission equipment, alongside continued growth in machine‑tool orders.

Basic metal and automotive parts: Basic metal rose 1.39% YoY, reflecting a gradual recovery in market demand and higher output of hot‑rolled steel coils, plates and target materials. The automotive and parts sector, buoyed by warming demand and supportive electric‑vehicle policies, grew 2.35% YoY.

Chemical materials and fertilizer: This sector declined 4.29% YoY as demand for some products remained weak, although polished silicon wafers benefited from ongoing semiconductor demand and saw production increases.

Looking forward, the Ministry of Economic Affairs notes that while global economic growth is still subject to geopolitical and trade‑policy uncertainties, the expanding demand for emerging technologies such as AI, high‑performance computing and cloud services, together with aggressive AI infrastructure investments by major cloud providers, will help sustain production momentum in Taiwan’s advanced semiconductor processes, high‑end packaging and server supply chains. Coupled with the upcoming year‑end consumer‑spending season, these factors are expected to support steady growth in the nation’s manufacturing output. The ministry estimates the October manufacturing production index will range from 141.56 to 145.86, reflecting a 20.5% to 24.2% annual increase.

items.title: 台積電運動會因颱風喊卡 「小禮物」特別獎金正常發放加碼到3萬元
items.title_en: TSMC Sports Day Cancelled by Typhoon, ‘Small Gift’ Special Bonus Still Paid and Boosted to NT$30,000
paras: 台積電(2330-TW)原定於10月24日運動會因為颱風薔琵取消，不過，「小禮物」特別獎金據悉仍將照常發出，且加碼達3萬元，高於去年的2.5萬元。
台積電近年運動會都發放特別獎金，且逐年加碼，從2023年1.6萬元、到2024年2萬元、2025年2.5萬元，到今年3萬元，只要符合資格的員工均可領到。
受到薔琵颱風影響，新竹縣市政府公告10月23日停止上班，台積電表示，由於運動會的準備工作也受到影響，考量人員安全，因此運動會將取消辦理。
paras_en: TSMC (2330‑TW) had scheduled its annual sports day for October 24, but the event was called off because of Typhoon Chanh‑pi. However, the “small‑gift” special bonus is reportedly still being issued as usual, and the amount has been increased to NT$30,000, up from NT$25,000 last year.

In recent years TSMC has awarded a special bonus at its sports day and has been raising the amount each year—NT$16,000 in 2023, NT$20,000 in 2024, NT$25,000 in 2025, and this year NT$30,000. Any employee who meets the eligibility criteria will receive the bonus.

Due to the impact of Typhoon Chanh‑pi, the Hsinchu County and City governments announced a work‑stop on October 23. TSMC said that because the preparation for the sports day was also affected and to ensure staff safety, the event will be cancelled.

items.title: 聯茂8、9月合賺22.1億元EPS 6.08元超越H1 前3季提前賺逾一股本
items.title_en: Lianmao Posts NT$2.21 B Combined Profit for August‑September, EPS NT$6.08 Beats H1; First Three Quarters Earn Over One Year’s Capital in Advance
paras: CCL廠聯茂電子(6213-TW)今(23)日公布最新獲利資訊，2026年9月營收達58.24億元，創歷史新高，單月稅後純益達12.86億元，每股純益(EPS)3.54元。加計8月稅後純益9.24億元，聯茂第三季光兩個月累計稅後純益就達22.1億元，每股純益合計6.08元，不僅獲利表現強勁，更已超越上半年稅後純益15.94億元。
聯茂2026年上半年營收為206.73億元，毛利率17.33%，稅後純益15.94億元，每股純益4.39元。若加計第三季8、9月獲利，前三季累計稅後純益已達38.04億元，每股純益合計10.47元，提前賺逾一個股本，獲利動能持續升溫。
在高階產品需求強勁帶動下，聯茂積極擴充泰國、江西、無錫及台灣等生產基地產能，預計2026年全球總產能將達每月570萬張。其中，泰國大型生產基地持續推進三期投資計畫，第一期預計於今年底完成，屆時產能將由每月30萬張倍增至60萬張，進一步提升高階材料供應能力。
聯茂泰國第二期擴產計畫也已打樁動工，初期規劃新增每月30萬張產能，公司規劃最快於2026年投產。隨著各地擴產計畫陸續推進，聯茂預估2029年全球總產能將進一步擴大至每月915萬張，持續因應AI及高階電子材料市場需求。
同時，聯茂持續提升泰國廠的技術層次，以因應在地PCB廠的擴廠生產需求，預計聯茂泰國廠於2026年完成M8 CCL的技術轉移，並於2027年完成M9產品技術轉移至泰國。而聯茂本身在M10產品的開發也在認證之中。
聯茂董事長陳進財先前指出，聯茂自2026年至2030年的全球生產規劃皆已完備，目前正依進度進行投資，但2026年尚無在公開市場籌資的規劃。
聯茂9月營收達58.2億元，月增15.5%、年增110.7%；第三季營收達156億元，優於市場預期並再創單季歷史新高。累計前9月營收達329.05億元，已超越歷年全年營收。法人分析，主要受惠於產品漲價效益持續反映，以及伺服器市場需求維持強勁。
paras_en: CCL manufacturer Lianmao Electronics (6213‑TW) today (23) announced the latest profit information, September 2026 revenue reached NT$5.824 billion, a historic high, monthly after‑tax net profit was NT$1.286 billion, EPS NT$3.54. Adding August after‑tax profit of NT$924 million, Lianmao’s Q3 two‑month cumulative after‑tax profit reached NT$2.21 billion, EPS total NT$6.08, not only a strong performance but already exceeds the H1 after‑tax profit of NT$1.594 billion.

Lianmao’s H1 2026 revenue was NT$20.673 billion, gross margin 17.33%, after‑tax profit NT$1.594 billion, EPS NT$4.39. Including Q3 August‑September profit, the first three quarters cumulative after‑tax profit reached NT$3.804 billion, EPS NT$10.47, earning more than one year’s equity in advance, and profit momentum continues to heat up.

Driven by strong demand for high‑end products, Lianmao is actively expanding capacity at its plants in Thailand, Jiangxi, Wuxi and Taiwan, expecting total global capacity in 2026 to reach 5.7 million sheets per month. The large Thailand plant continues its Phase‑3 investment, with Phase‑1 expected to be completed by year‑end, raising capacity from 300,000 to 600,000 sheets per month, further boosting high‑end material supply capability.

The second‑phase expansion at the Thailand plant has also begun pile‑driving, initially adding 300,000 sheets per month, with the company planning to start production as early as 2026. As expansion projects progress, Lianmao forecasts global capacity to grow to 9.15 million sheets per month by 2029, continuing to meet AI and high‑end electronic material market demand.

At the same time, Lianmao is upgrading the technology level of its Thailand factory to meet local PCB fab expansion needs, expecting to complete M8 CCL technology transfer at the Thailand plant in 2026 and finish M9 product technology transfer there in 2027. Lianmao’s own M10 product development is also under certification.

Chairman Chen Jin‑cai previously noted that Lianmao’s global production plan for 2026‑2030 is fully set, and investments are proceeding on schedule, but there is no plan to raise capital in the public market in 2026.

Lianmao’s September revenue hit NT$5.82 billion, up 15.5% month‑over‑month and 110.7% year‑over‑year; Q3 revenue reached NT$15.6 billion, beating market expectations and setting a new quarterly record. Cumulative revenue for the first nine months reached NT$32.905 billion, surpassing any full‑year revenue in history. Analysts say the results are mainly due to continued price‑increase benefits and strong server market demand.

items.title: 玉晶光獲3M參與私募股款已到位持股4.68% 自結9月EPS達3.85元
items.title_en: Yujing Optical Secures 3M Participation in Private Placement, Stake Reaches 4.68%, September EPS Hits T$3.85
paras: 獲美商3M以逾48億元參與私募現增案並取得約 4.68% 股權的光學鏡頭與精密光學元件大廠玉晶光(3406-TW)，今(23)日公布最新自結獲利資訊，玉晶光2026年9月營收26.72億元，月減1.75%，年增0.54%，自結單月稅後純益4.34億元，年減15%，單月每股純益3.85元。
玉晶光第三季為客戶傳統鋪貨旺季，單季營收表現也佳，達 78.16 億元，進入歷史高檔區，季增37.55%，年增1%。2026年1-9月玉晶光營收196.31億元，年增10.21%。
展望第四季營運，玉晶光指出，端視客戶新機銷售狀況，另其它領域的產品目前仍在積極送樣、認證，目前進度符合公司預期。
3M 預計參與玉晶光的私募發行新股，認購玉晶光普通股5534張，每股認購價格為869.6元，投資總金額高達48.13億元（約1.5億美金元），股款並已匯入，3M透過參與私募將取得玉晶光約 4.68%股權。
玉晶光與3M的大舉合作，雙方合作結合了 3M 在 EBO 技術的領導地位、材料科學、光學設計及全球客戶網絡，與玉晶光長期積累的精密光學鏡頭製造能力、量產規模及高精度組裝技術。玉晶光的生產團隊將全力支援 3M EBO 套管（ferrules）、共封裝光學（CPO）解決方案及相關光互連模組的量產做準備。
玉晶光在2026年上半年營收118.23億元，毛利率33.37%，稅後純益15.77億元，每股純益13.99元。
paras_en: Yujing Optical (3406‑TW), a leading manufacturer of optical lenses and precision optical components that received participation from U.S. company 3M in a private placement raising over T$4.8 billion and acquiring about a 4.68% stake, announced its latest self‑reported profit figures today (23rd). For September 2026, Yujing posted revenue of T$2.672 billion, down 1.75% month‑over‑month but up 0.54% year‑over‑year, with a net profit after tax of T$434 million, a 15% year‑over‑year decline, and earnings per share of T$3.85 for the month.

The third quarter, traditionally a strong distribution season for customers, saw Yujing’s quarterly revenue reach T$7.816 billion, entering a historically high range, up 37.55% quarter‑over‑quarter and 1% year‑over‑year. For the January‑September 2026 period, Yujing’s revenue totaled T$19.631 billion, a 10.21% increase year‑over‑year.

Looking ahead to the fourth quarter, Yujing said its performance will depend on customers’ new product sales, while products in other segments are still being actively sampled and certified, with progress currently meeting the company’s expectations.

3M plans to participate in Yujing’s private placement of new shares, subscribing to 5,534 ordinary shares at a price of T$869.6 per share, for a total investment of T$4.813 billion (approximately US$150 million). The funds have already been transferred, and through this private placement 3M will obtain roughly a 4.68% equity stake in Yujing.

The extensive collaboration between Yujing and 3M combines 3M’s leadership in EBO technology, material science, optical design, and its global customer network with Yujing’s long‑standing precision optical lens manufacturing capability, mass‑production scale, and high‑precision assembly technology. Yujing’s production team will fully support the mass‑production preparation of 3M’s EBO ferrules, co‑packaged optics (CPO) solutions, and related optical interconnect modules.
In the first half of 2026, Yujing reported revenue of T$11.823 billion, a gross margin of 33.37%, net profit after tax of T$1.577 billion, and earnings per share of T$13.99.

items.title: Anthropic會延後「超級IPO」嗎？AI股回檔添變數、時程相當緊迫
items.title_en: Will Anthropic Delay Its "Super IPO"? AI Stocks Pull Back Adds Uncertainty, Timeline Very Tight
paras: 人工智慧（AI）新創公司Anthropic傳出計畫於11月中旬完成首次公開發行（IPO），目標估值高達2兆美元，有望成為史上規模最大的科技IPO之一。不過，近期AI概念股遭遇賣壓，加上美國證券交易委員會（SEC）對招股文件公開時間的要求，讓Anthropic的上市時程面臨壓力。
根據《路透》報導，依規定，公司必須在上市路演開始至少15天前公開提交招股說明書（S-1文件），因此若要趕上原定時程，留給Anthropic準備的時間已相當有限。
若Anthropic以2兆美元估值上市，規模將超越SpaceX(SPCX-US) 今年稍早1.77兆美元的上市規模。
與此同時，市場近期對AI產業支出能否持續的疑慮也持續升高。新興雲端運算公司CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 股價在兩周內下跌約30%，記憶體大廠美光科技(MU-US) 近一個月則下跌17%。
市場人士認為，這波回檔可能影響Anthropic的上市決策，但公司對資金的需求，也可能促使其繼續推進IPO計畫。
預測市場目前估計，Anthropic年底前上市的機率約為80%。
佛羅里達大學IPO研究計畫負責人Jay Ritter表示，若Anthropic希望在感恩節前完成上市，時間仍然充裕，但時程已相當緊迫。
若公司將IPO日期訂在最晚11月24日，並於11月16日啟動路演，就必須在下周末前公開提交S-1文件。
Anthropic先前原本被預期會在美國勞工節後不久公開招股說明書，市場當時一度預估公司可能於9月下旬掛牌，但最終並未如期推進。

AI股遭拋售　市場憂支出與融資前景

根據《MarketWatch》報導，近期AI相關股票大幅修正，是Anthropic管理層必須納入考量的重要因素。
因市場擔憂CoreWeave債務管理能力，該公司股價兩周內下跌約30%；美光近一個月跌幅則達17%，反映投資人對AI支出規模及融資前景的疑慮升溫。
Rational Equity Armor Fund投資組合經理Joe Tigay也指出，持續的通膨壓力與高漲的能源價格同樣令人擔憂。
他認為，從歷史經驗來看，經濟成長放緩與通膨並存，往往是股市出現問題的前兆。若相關壓力持續累積，Anthropic可能選擇暫緩上市，留在私人市場等待更有利的時機。
不過，也有市場人士認為，Anthropic成功上市有助於重振投資人對AI產業的信心。
Cerity Partners首席市場策略師Jim Lebenthal表示，市場近期對AI產業的長期發展潛力與商業模式提出更多質疑，因此需要一場成功的Anthropic IPO，證明AI產業具備持續發展的能力。
他指出，市場提出疑問甚至產生懷疑並不為過，但美國股市與整體經濟的健康，在很大程度上仍取決於AI產業能否成功。

AI算力支出龐大　資金需求成上市推力

分析指出，除了市場環境，Anthropic自身對資金的迫切需求，也可能是推動公司如期上市的關鍵因素。
Zacks Investment Research股票策略師Andrew Rocco表示，大型AI公司已展現出願意大規模投入資金的態度，希望藉此吸引更多用戶，並爭取成為市場主導者。
他認為，Anthropic將努力推進IPO，因為公司確實需要這筆資金，尤其當私人市場融資可能變得更加困難時，上市將成為重要的資金來源。
根據《華爾街日報》報導，Anthropic的招股說明書草案顯示，公司未來數年在AI算力方面的支出可能高達7,500億美元。
此外，草案顯示，Anthropic在2026年上半年錄得逾800億美元淨虧損，營收則為163億美元。報導指出，這筆虧損主要來自會計調整，而非基本業務狀況惡化。
paras_en: AI startup Anthropic is reported to plan completing its initial public offering (IPO) in mid‑November, targeting a valuation of up to $2 trillion, which could make it one of the largest tech IPOs ever. However, recent selling pressure on AI‑related stocks and the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission’s (SEC) timing requirements for filing prospectuses are putting pressure on Anthropic’s listing schedule.

According to Reuters, regulations require a company to publicly file its S‑1 registration statement at least 15 days before the start of the road‑show. That leaves Anthropic very little time to prepare if it wants to stick to the original timetable.
If Anthropic lists at a $2 trillion valuation, its size would surpass SpaceX (SPCX‑US), which earlier this year went public at $1.77 trillion.

At the same time, market doubts about whether AI‑industry spending can be sustained are rising. Emerging cloud‑computing firm CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) has seen its share price fall about 30% over two weeks, and memory‑chip giant Micron Technology (MU‑US) has dropped 17% in the past month.
Market participants think this pull‑back could affect Anthropic’s IPO decision, but the company’s need for capital may also push it to continue with the offering plan.
Current market forecasts estimate roughly an 80% chance that Anthropic will go public before the end of the year.

Jay Ritter, head of the University of Florida’s IPO research project, said that if Anthropic wants to complete the listing before Thanksgiving, there is still time, but the schedule is extremely tight.
If the company sets the latest IPO date for November 24 and starts the road‑show on November 16, it must file the S‑1 publicly by the weekend before next week.
Anthropic had originally been expected to file its prospectus shortly after U.S. Labor Day, and the market at that time briefly expected a late‑September listing, but that timeline was not met.
AI stocks are being sold off, and market worries about spending and financing outlooks are key considerations for Anthropic’s management, according to MarketWatch.

Because the market is concerned about CoreWeave’s debt‑management ability, its shares have fallen about 30% in two weeks; Micron’s one‑month decline of 17% reflects rising investor anxiety over AI spending levels and financing prospects.
Joe Tigay, portfolio manager of the Rational Equity Armor Fund, also noted that persistent inflation pressure and high energy prices are cause for concern.

He believes that historically, a slowdown in economic growth combined with inflation often precedes stock‑market trouble. If those pressures continue to build, Anthropic may choose to postpone its listing and stay private until conditions improve.
However, some market participants argue that a successful Anthropic IPO would help revive investor confidence in the AI sector.

Jim Lebenthal, chief market strategist at Cerity Partners, said that recent doubts about the AI industry’s long‑term potential and business models mean a successful Anthropic IPO is needed to prove the sector’s ability to sustain growth.
He added that questioning and even skepticism about the industry are understandable, but the health of U.S. equities and the broader economy largely depends on whether AI can succeed.
Massive AI compute spending and funding needs are driving forces behind the IPO push, analysts note, alongside market conditions.
Andrew Rocco, stock strategist at Zacks Investment Research, said large AI firms have shown a willingness to invest heavily to attract users and aim for market leadership.
He believes Anthropic will push ahead with the IPO because it truly needs the capital, especially as private‑market financing may become harder, making the public market an important source of funds.
A draft of Anthropic’s prospectus, reported by the Wall Street Journal, shows the company could spend as much as $750 billion on AI compute over the next several years.

The draft also shows Anthropic recorded a net loss of over $80 billion in the first half of 2026, with revenue of $16.3 billion. The report notes the loss is mainly due to accounting adjustments rather than a deterioration of core business conditions.

items.title: Meta探索AI變現新路：Muse不放廣告、購物抽成與企業服務收費
items.title_en: Meta Explores New AI Monetization Paths: Muse Free of Ads, Shopping Commissions, and Enterprise Service Fees
paras: Meta(META-US) 正為人工智慧（AI）業務開拓廣告以外的收入來源。Meta首席AI長Alexandr Wang表示，個人AI代理Muse將維持免廣告，一般用戶可免費使用，高階功能則採訂閱制，並規劃推出企業付費服務，以及從AI代理促成的購物交易中收取佣金。
Wang接受《日經新聞》訪問時指出，Muse不僅能回答問題，還能代替使用者執行任務，協助節省時間與金錢，因此比先前的AI產品更實用。
Muse於9月8日在北美上線，六週內應用程式下載量達到1,000萬次，成長速度超越包括ChatGPT在內的部分競爭產品，並於10月23日首度進軍日本市場。
免費吸引用戶 高階功能採訂閱制
Meta希望未來將Muse推廣至數十億用戶，目前對一般使用者免費開放，並已針對重度用戶及希望使用最先進模型的用戶推出訂閱方案。此外，公司也計劃提供企業付費服務，但尚未揭露具體收費標準與推出時間。
與Meta旗下社群平台仰賴廣告的營運模式不同，Wang明確表示：「Muse內部沒有廣告，我們也沒有投放廣告的計畫。」這意味著，按照目前規劃，Meta不會直接在Muse的互動介面置入廣告。
對廣告收入占比超過95%的Meta而言，Muse提供了探索其他收入來源的機會。隨著產品拓展至更多市場，加上公司持續斥資建設AI基礎設施，如何將用戶成長轉化為可持續的收入，成為市場關注焦點。
AI代理協助購物 Meta規劃抽佣
除了個人訂閱與企業服務，Meta也計劃從用戶透過AI代理完成的購物交易中抽取佣金，讓Muse的應用從資訊查詢、任務協助延伸至購物。
這項模式可望為Meta帶來廣告以外的交易收入，但實際執行方式仍待釐清。公司尚未公布佣金比例、適用商家範圍與正式推出時間。
未來能創造多少收入，將取決於Muse執行任務的能力、商家串接情況，以及使用者是否願意將購物決策交給AI代理。
擴大基礎建設 支撐產品發展
Wang認為，Meta自有的技術基礎設施、安全體系與資料中心，是競爭對手難以複製的重要優勢。個人AI代理需要執行任務、處理使用者資訊並串接不同服務，除了模型能力，基礎設施的規模、可靠性與安全性也相當重要。
Meta週三(21日)於美股盤後公布財報時，將2026年資本支出預估區間調整為1,350億至1,450億美元，下限較先前提高50億美元。
公司22日提交的監管文件另顯示，截至9月底，尚未開始履行的租賃義務與不可撤銷合約承諾合計約8,100億美元。若納入最高約147億美元的或有雲端運算容量採購義務，未來承諾投入總額接近8,250億美元。
上述投入除支援Meta現有業務，也將用於新一代AI模型與產品開發。龐大的基礎建設能否提升產品能力，進而帶動訂閱、企業服務與交易佣金收入，將是Muse商業化進展的關鍵。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) is seeking revenue streams beyond advertising for its artificial intelligence (AI) business. Meta’s chief AI officer Alexandr Wang said the personal AI agent Muse will remain ad‑free, with general users able to use it for free, while premium features will be subscription‑based. The company also plans to launch paid enterprise services and to take a commission on shopping transactions facilitated by the AI agent.

In an interview with the Nikkei, Wang noted that Muse not only answers questions but can also perform tasks on behalf of users, helping them save time and money, making it more practical than previous AI products.

Muse launched in North America on September 8 and amassed 10 million app downloads within six weeks, growing faster than several competing products including ChatGPT, and entered the Japanese market for the first time on October 23.
Free to attract users, premium features subscription‑based

Meta hopes to eventually roll Muse out to billions of users. It is currently free for ordinary users, and a subscription plan has been introduced for heavy users and those who want access to the most advanced models. The company also plans to offer paid enterprise services, though it has not disclosed pricing or rollout timing.

Unlike Meta’s ad‑driven social platforms, Wang made it clear: “There are no ads inside Muse, and we have no plans to run ads.” This means that, under current plans, Meta will not place advertisements directly in Muse’s interaction interface.

For Meta, whose ad revenue accounts for more than 95% of its income, Muse offers an opportunity to explore other revenue sources. As the product expands into more markets and the company continues to invest heavily in AI infrastructure, the question of how to turn user growth into sustainable revenue has become a focal point for the market.
AI agent assists shopping, Meta plans commissions

In addition to personal subscriptions and enterprise services, Meta also plans to take a commission on shopping transactions completed by users through the AI agent, extending Muse’s use from information lookup and task assistance to commerce.

This model could generate transaction revenue for Meta beyond advertising, but the exact implementation details remain unclear. The company has not disclosed the commission rate, the range of applicable merchants, or the official launch date.

How much revenue it can eventually generate will depend on Muse’s task‑execution capabilities, merchant integration, and whether users are willing to entrust their purchasing decisions to an AI agent.
Expanding infrastructure to support product development

Wang believes Meta’s own technology infrastructure, security systems, and data centers constitute a significant advantage that rivals cannot easily replicate. A personal AI agent must execute tasks, process user data, and connect to various services; beyond model capability, the scale, reliability, and security of the underlying infrastructure are equally critical.

When Meta reported earnings after the U.S. market close on Wednesday (the 21st), it revised its 2026 capital‑expenditure outlook to a range of $135 billion to $145 billion, raising the lower end by $5 billion from its prior estimate.

Regulatory filings submitted on the 22nd show that as of the end of September, unfulfilled lease obligations and irrevocable contract commitments total about $810 billion. Including up to roughly $14.7 billion of potential cloud‑computing capacity purchase obligations, the total future commitment approaches $825 billion.

These investments will support Meta’s existing businesses as well as the development of next‑generation AI models and products. Whether the massive infrastructure boost can enhance product capabilities and drive subscription, enterprise service, and transaction‑commission revenue will be key to Muse’s commercialization progress.

items.title: 高盛示警：AI恐取代9%勞工！經濟若衰退恐加劇裁員
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Warns: AI Could Replace 9% of Workers; Recession Could Accelerate Layoffs
paras: 人工智慧(AI)對就業市場的影響前景不容樂觀，根據高盛(Goldman Sachs)最新預測，最多可能有9%勞工被迫離開目前的工作崗位，相當於約1500萬名勞工的工作受到AI衝擊。
高盛首席經濟學家Jan Hatzius去年曾預測，AI可能取代美國6%至7%的勞工，但根據高盛更新後的預測，勞工遭取代的比率可能達到9%。
高盛的基本情境假設美國及其他已開發經濟體的生產力提高15%。

AI衝擊就業恐逐步升溫 經濟衰退可能加速自動化

報告指出，AI的採用也可能因整體招聘放緩而對就業市場造成壓力。不過，AI對整體失業率的影響，可能更多來自實際工作職位遭到裁撤，而非企業減少招聘。
Hatzius說：「根據我們對明年經濟成長接近潛在成長率的基本預測，估算結果顯示，AI對勞動市場的衝擊可能只會逐步擴大，而不是突然對就業市場造成衝擊。」
高盛預估，美國的AI採用仍處於初期階段，目前將AI納入日常工作流程的企業不到四分之一。
Hatzius表示，如果美國經濟陷入衰退，AI的採用速度可能加快。他援引高盛對過去經濟衰退期間自動化發展周期的分析指出，景氣下滑可能促使企業加速導入自動化技術。
他寫道：「我們分析中更令人擔憂的結論是，景氣循環放緩可能加速與AI相關的自動化及裁員，進而放大整體景氣循環的波動。」

AI裁員仍是企業縮編主因 入門白領工作面臨威脅

市場對AI可能造成失業的恐慌已略為降溫，但部分研究人員仍擔心，AI未來可能大幅削減入門級白領工作。
美國企業9月宣布的裁員數有所下降，但AI仍是企業最常提及的裁員原因，占所有已宣布裁員人數的21%。
根據Challenger, Gray & Christmas的數據，科技業的裁員情況也比其他任何產業嚴重，9月占所有裁員人數的29%。
paras_en: The impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on the labor market looks bleak; according to Goldman Sachs' latest forecast, up to 9% of workers could be forced out of their current jobs, roughly 15 million workers affected by AI.
Goldman Sachs chief economist Jan Hatzius last year predicted that AI might replace 6% to 7% of U.S. workers, but the updated forecast puts the replacement rate at as high as 9%.
Goldman's baseline scenario assumes a 15% productivity increase in the United States and other developed economies.

AI's impact on employment could gradually intensify, and an economic recession may speed up automation. The report notes that AI adoption could also strain the labor market as overall hiring slows, but the effect on the overall unemployment rate is likely to come more from actual job cuts than from firms hiring less.

Hatzius said, "Based on our baseline projection that next year's economic growth will be close to potential growth, the estimate shows that AI's impact on the labor market will likely expand gradually rather than shock the job market suddenly."
Goldman estimates that AI adoption in the United States is still in its early stage, with fewer than a quarter of firms currently integrating AI into daily workflows.

Hatzius added that if the U.S. economy falls into a recession, the pace of AI adoption could accelerate. He cited Goldman’s analysis of automation cycles during past downturns, noting that a slowdown in activity may prompt firms to speed up the deployment of automation technologies.
He wrote, "A more concerning conclusion from our analysis is that a slowdown in the business cycle could hasten AI‑related automation and layoffs, thereby amplifying overall economic volatility."

AI-driven layoffs remain a primary reason for corporate downsizing, putting entry‑level white‑collar jobs at risk. While market panic over AI‑induced unemployment has eased somewhat, some researchers still worry that AI could sharply cut entry‑level white‑collar positions in the future.
U.S. companies reported a slight decline in announced layoffs in September, but AI remained the most frequently cited reason for cuts, accounting for 21% of all announced layoffs.
According to data from Challenger, Gray & Christmas, the tech sector experienced the most severe layoffs of any industry, representing 29% of all layoffs in September.

items.title: 散戶抄底半導體股慘套牢！SOXL單周吸金61億美元、10月暴跌逾43%
items.title_en: Retail Investors Trapped in Bottom‑Buying Semiconductor Stocks! SOXL Draws $6.1 B in a Week, Falls Over 43% in October
paras: 美股半導體股跌勢加劇，押注反彈的散戶投資人反而面臨更大損失。FactSet數據顯示，追蹤半導體指數每日報酬3倍的槓桿型ETF Direxion 每日3倍看多半導體ETF(SOXL-US) 上周單周吸引創紀錄的61億美元資金流入，但晶片股不僅未如預期反彈，跌勢反而進一步擴大，讓進場抄底的資金迅速陷入虧損。
根據FactSet數據，SOXL上周單周流入61億美元，創下歷史新高。這檔ETF旨在提供半導體指數每日漲跌幅的3倍報酬，屬於風險較高的槓桿投資工具。
資金大舉湧入之際，半導體股已經歷一波下跌，市場對AI交易的熱情也開始降溫。部分投資人押注，股價跌幅愈大，短期反彈的機會就愈高。
然而，資金流入持續至周四，SOXL當天卻暴跌20.5%，創6月23日以來最大單日跌幅。SOXL本周再跌10.8%，連續第3周收黑，10月以來累計跌幅已超過43%。
相較之下，非槓桿型的安碩半導體ETF(SOXX-US) 當日下跌6.8%，跌幅明顯較小。
市場賣壓主要來自投資人對人工智慧（AI）投資回報的疑慮。隨著科技巨頭持續大舉投入AI基礎設施，市場開始重新檢視相關支出能否轉化為足夠的獲利，半導體股也因此承受估值壓力。
與此同時，美股三大指數周五（23日）全數收跌，標普500資訊科技類股更連續3周下跌，寫下自3月以來最長連跌紀錄。
受惠於AI晶片需求快速成長，半導體股今年以來曾大幅上漲，安碩半導體ETF年內一度飆升近59%。不過，隨著市場開始檢視AI基礎設施投資的實際回報，半導體股原有的漲勢正面臨挑戰。
財富管理公司Glenmede投資策略副總裁Mike Reynolds指出，半導體產業與AI基礎設施建設高度相關，目前市場對AI投資題材已出現一定程度的質疑。
他也認為，在股價經歷強勁上漲、估值大幅攀升後，投資人重新評估AI題材的潛在回報，屬於健康的市場現象。
Reynolds表示，與其等到市場熱潮完全脫離基本面後才提出疑問，投資人及早檢視相關投資的合理性，反而有助於市場調整。
分析指出，SOXL的表現再次凸顯槓桿ETF的風險。這類產品透過衍生性金融商品放大每日報酬，在市場上漲時可能帶來較高收益，但當行情走勢與投資方向相反時，損失也會迅速擴大。
10月以來，SOXL累計下跌逾43%，同期SOXX跌幅約15.9%，兩者差距反映3倍槓桿在下跌行情中的放大效果。
半導體股本月的劇烈波動，也多次影響標普500指數的單日表現，顯示AI投資情緒已成為牽動美股的重要因素。
對押注短期反彈的投資人而言，這波行情不僅是方向判斷失準，更凸顯槓桿產品的風險：當市場持續下跌，原本期待放大獲利的工具，也可能迅速放大虧損。
paras_en: The decline in U.S. semiconductor stocks has intensified, leaving retail investors who bet on a rebound facing even greater losses. FactSet data shows that the leveraged ETF tracking the semiconductor index at three times daily returns, Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X Shares (SOXL‑US), attracted a record $6.1 billion of inflows last week, yet chip stocks not only failed to rebound as expected but instead fell further, quickly turning the bottom‑buying capital into losses.

According to FactSet, SOXL drew $6.1 billion last week, setting a new historical high. This ETF aims to deliver three times the daily performance of the semiconductor index and is a high‑risk leveraged investment vehicle.

When the capital surged in, semiconductor stocks had already been on a downward trend, and enthusiasm for AI trading was cooling. Some investors bet that the larger the price decline, the higher the chance of a short‑term rebound.

However, the inflow continued until Thursday, when SOXL plunged 20.5% that day, its largest single‑day drop since June 23. SOXL fell 10.8% this week, marking its third consecutive week of losses, and its cumulative decline since October has exceeded 43%.
In contrast, the non‑leveraged iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX‑US) fell 6.8% that day, a noticeably smaller decline.

Market selling pressure mainly stemmed from investors’ doubts about the returns of AI investments. As tech giants continue to pour large sums into AI infrastructure, the market has begun to reassess whether such spending can translate into sufficient profits, putting valuation pressure on semiconductor stocks.

Meanwhile, all three U.S. major indices fell on Friday (23rd), and the S&P 500 Information Technology sector dropped for the third consecutive week, marking the longest streak of declines since March.

Benefiting from rapid growth in AI chip demand, semiconductor stocks have surged this year, with the iShares Semiconductor ETF soaring nearly 59% year‑to‑date. However, as the market starts to scrutinize the actual returns of AI infrastructure investments, the previous upward momentum of semiconductor stocks is facing challenges.

Mike Reynolds, Vice President of Investment Strategies at wealth‑management firm Glenmede, noted that the semiconductor industry is highly correlated with AI infrastructure construction, and that the market has begun to question the AI investment theme to some extent.
He also believes that after a strong rally and a significant rise in valuations, investors reassessing the potential returns of AI themes is a healthy market phenomenon.

Reynolds said that rather than waiting for the market hype to completely detach from fundamentals before raising questions, early scrutiny of the rationality of such investments actually helps the market adjust.

Analysis points out that SOXL’s performance again highlights the risks of leveraged ETFs. These products amplify daily returns through derivatives; they can yield higher gains when markets rise, but when the trend moves against the investment direction, losses can expand rapidly.
Since October, SOXL has fallen over 43% cumulatively, while SOXX has declined about 15.9% in the same period, reflecting the magnified effect of three‑times leverage in a downtrend.
The sharp volatility of semiconductor stocks this month has repeatedly impacted the daily performance of the S&P 500, showing that AI investment sentiment has become a key driver of U.S. equities.

For investors betting on a short‑term rebound, this market move not only reflects a misjudgment of direction but also underscores the risk of leveraged products: when the market continues to fall, tools that were expected to amplify gains can quickly amplify losses.

items.title: 亞馬遜CEO：雲端算力已售罄至2027年
items.title_en: Amazon CEO: Cloud Compute Capacity Sold Out Through 2027
