paras: 《路透社》報導，亞馬遜(Amazon)(AMZN-US)執行長Andy Jassy週五(23日)表示，受人工智慧（AI）基礎建設需求持續成長帶動，亞馬遜網路服務（Amazon Web Services, AWS）的雲端運算產能大部分已被預訂至2027年，部分大量產能的預約更延伸至2028年。
Jassy在與Andreessen Horowitz共同創辦人Ben Horowitz及合夥人Erik Torenberg參與的Podcast影片中表示，面對AI實驗室與企業近乎無止盡的需求，亞馬遜正努力追趕。
亞馬遜今年稍早曾表示，2026年資本支出將達約2,200億美元。
Jassy表示，考量到2026年的雲端運算產能已經售罄，公司「即使投入更多資本，也不會是糟糕的資金運用」。
他談到，「2027年的產能大部分已經售罄。我們一向會保留一定比例的產能，供客戶按需使用，以及提供我們的推論服務Bedrock或EC2，但大部分的產能都已售罄。2028年也有相當大一部分產能已被預訂。」
EC2是AWS提供的雲端服務，讓客戶使用雲端伺服器執行應用程式，Bedrock則讓客戶存取AI模型，以開發生成式AI應用程式。
亞馬遜預定於10月29日盤後公布第三季財報。
paras_en: Reuters reported that Amazon (AMZN-US) CEO Andy Jassy said on Friday (the 23rd) that, driven by the continued growth in demand for artificial‑intelligence (AI) infrastructure, most of Amazon Web Services’ (AWS) cloud computing capacity has already been booked out through 2027, with some large‑scale reservations extending into 2028.

Jassy said in a podcast video that also featured Andreessen Horowitz co‑founder Ben Horowitz and partner Erik Torenberg that Amazon is working hard to keep up with the near‑endless demand from AI labs and enterprises.
Amazon earlier this year indicated that its 2026 capital expenditures would total roughly $220 billion.
Jassy noted that, given cloud compute capacity is already sold out for 2026, the company “would not be making a poor use of capital even if we invest more.”

He added, “Most of the capacity for 2027 is already sold out. We always keep a certain proportion of capacity available for on‑demand use by customers and for our inference services such as Bedrock or EC2, but the bulk of the capacity is sold out. A sizable portion of 2028 capacity has also been booked.”
EC2 is AWS’s cloud service that lets customers run applications on virtual servers, while Bedrock allows customers to access AI models to develop generative‑AI applications.
Amazon is scheduled to release its third‑quarter earnings after market close on October 29.

items.title: 美股罕見訊號浮現！1999年來僅見第2次 花旗：逢低買點還沒到
items.title_en: Rare Signal Emerges in US Stocks! Only the Second Occurrence Since 1999, Citi Says the Buying Dip Has Not Arrived
paras: 美股週四 (22 日) 出現罕見走勢：標普 500 指數重挫約 1.2%，成分股卻漲多跌少，上漲家數比下跌家數多出 173 家。花旗指出，這種指數跌逾 1%、上漲家數卻比下跌家數多出逾 150 家的情況，是 1999 年以來第 2 次出現。儘管前次曾帶動隔日反彈，後續走勢仍不穩，現階段增加股票曝險仍有風險。
《MarketWatch》報導，花旗美國股票交易策略主管 Stuart Kaiser 在週四報告中表示，這波跌勢主要由大型科技股遭到拋售所驅動，資金則轉向商業服務、區域銀行與運輸等指數權重較低的族群，形成指數下跌、多數成分股卻上漲的分化局面。
Kaiser 指出，投資人明顯撤離成長股、獲利預估上修動能及股價動能等投資題材，人工智慧 (AI) 交易首當其衝，與 AI 發展瓶頸及電力需求相關的題材也遭到重擊。
他認為，這波賣壓更像是多項風險累積的結果，包括市場對 Meta (META-US) AI 策略的疑慮、法國公債殖利率攀升，以及油價上漲，而非單一事件引發。
值得注意的是，標普 500 指數採市值加權，大型權值股對指數影響較大。因此，即使多數成分股收紅，只要大型科技股跌幅夠深，仍可能拖累整體指數。
根據 Kaiser 的統計，自 1999 年以來，標普 500 單日跌逾 1%，同時上漲家數比下跌家數多出逾 150 家的情況，此前僅於 2025 年 1 月 27 日出現。當時指數隔日反彈約 0.9%，但隨後 5 個交易日中有 3 天下跌，顯示市場參與廣度改善，未必代表賣壓已經結束。
本輪財報季迄今偏弱的市場反應，也讓 Kaiser 維持審慎。他表示，花旗原先預期，機構投資人持倉偏低，將使第三季財報季具備較佳的風險報酬條件；但過去 2 週的市場反應顯示，要提振投資信心，企業必須跨越比預期更高的門檻。
花旗仍偏好資產負債表穩健的大型股與成長股，但 Kaiser 強調，持倉調整帶來的壓力相當明顯，現階段增加曝險仍是風險偏高的選擇，尚不能將這波回檔視為適合逢低買進的機會。
至於避險工具，他認為，追蹤那斯達克 100 指數的 Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ-US)，較適合用於因應持倉調整風險；追蹤羅素 2000 指數的 iShares Russell 2000 ETF (IWM-US)，則較適合對應信用、利率與政策疑慮。
paras_en: US stocks on Thursday (the 22nd) showed a rare pattern: the S&P 500 index plunged about 1.2%, yet more component stocks rose than fell, with 173 more advancing than declining. Citi noted that this situation—an index drop of over 1% while the number of advancing stocks exceeds decliners by more than 150—is only the second time since 1999. Although the previous instance sparked a rebound the next day, the subsequent trend remained unstable, and increasing equity exposure now still carries risk.

MarketWatch reported that Stuart Kaiser, head of US equity trading strategy at Citi, said in Thursday’s report that the decline was mainly driven by selling in large‑cap technology stocks, with capital rotating into lower‑weight sectors such as business services, regional banks and transportation, creating a divergence where the index fell but most components rose.

Kaiser pointed out that investors clearly pulled out of growth stocks, earnings‑upgrade momentum and price‑momentum themes; AI‑related trades were hit first, and topics tied to AI development bottlenecks and power‑demand also took a heavy blow.

He believes the selling pressure reflects a buildup of multiple risks, including doubts about Meta’s (META‑US) AI strategy, rising French government‑bond yields, and higher oil prices, rather than a single event.

It is worth noting that the S&P 500 is market‑cap weighted, so large‑cap stocks have a big impact on the index. Therefore, even if most components close higher, a deep enough decline in large‑cap tech stocks can still drag the overall index down.

According to Kaiser’s data, since 1999 the S&P 500 has fallen more than 1% in a day while the number of advancing stocks exceeded decliners by over 150 only once before, on Jan. 27 2025. At that time the index rebounded about 0.9% the next day, but three of the following five trading days were down, indicating that broader market participation improved and did not necessarily mean selling pressure had ended.

The relatively weak market reaction to earnings so far this season also keeps Kaiser cautious. He said Citi had originally expected that low institutional holdings would give the third‑quarter earnings season a better risk‑reward profile; however, the market response over the past two weeks shows that companies must clear a higher‑than‑expected hurdle to revive investor confidence.

Citi still prefers large‑cap and growth stocks with solid balance sheets, but Kaiser emphasized that the pressure from portfolio adjustments is quite evident, and increasing exposure at this stage remains a high‑risk choice; the pullback should not be seen as a low‑price buying opportunity.

As for hedging tools, he thinks the Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ‑US), which tracks the Nasdaq‑100, is more suitable for managing portfolio‑adjustment risk, while the iShares Russell 2000 ETF (IWM‑US), which tracks the Russell 2000, is more appropriate for addressing credit, rate and policy concerns.

items.title: 美國運通裁員5%人力 為「AI時代做好準備」
items.title_en: American Express Cuts 5% of Workforce to Prepare for the AI Era
paras: 《Investopedia》報導，跨國金融服務公司美國運通(American Express)(AXP-US)正在縮減員工人數，而人工智慧正是（AI）原因之一。
執行長Stephen Squeri週五(23日)在美國運通第三季財報電話會議上表示，這家金融服務巨頭本季認列3.36億美元的重整費用，與裁減全球約5%的職位有關。截至2025年底，美國運通在全球約有76,800名員工。
Squeri表示，「今年以來強勁的業務表現，讓我們得以增加行銷與科技投資，因此我們決定運用部分收益，投資於提升組織效率，讓公司更有效率，也為未來做好準備。」
財務長Christophe Le Caillec接受CNBC訪問時表示，此次重整旨在讓美國運通的組織「更精簡、更靈活，同時為AI做好準備」。
美國運通第三季調整後每股盈餘(EPS)為4.68美元，營收年增9%，達200.6億美元。
Visible Alpha調查的分析師原先預期，每股盈餘為4.49美元，營收為201.4億美元。此外，公司也上調全年每股盈餘展望。
美國運通股價週五下跌逾3.5%，今年以來則下跌15%。
paras_en: Investopedia reports that multinational financial services company American Express (AXP-US) is reducing its headcount, with artificial intelligence (AI) cited as one of the reasons.

Chief Executive Stephen Squeri said on Friday the 23rd during American Express' third‑quarter earnings call that the financial‑services giant recorded $336 million in restructuring charges this quarter, tied to a roughly 5% global workforce reduction. By the end of 2025, American Express will have about 76,800 employees worldwide.

Squeri added, "Strong business performance so far this year has allowed us to increase marketing and technology investments, so we decided to use part of the earnings to invest in improving organizational efficiency, making the company more effective and ready for the future."
Chief Financial Officer Christophe Le Caillec told CNBC that the restructuring is intended to make American Express' organization "leaner, more agile, and ready for AI."
American Express reported adjusted third‑quarter earnings per share (EPS) of $4.68, with revenue up 9% year‑over‑year to $20.06 billion.
Analysts surveyed by Visible Alpha had originally expected EPS of $4.49 and revenue of $20.14 billion, and the company also raised its full‑year EPS outlook.
American Express shares fell more than 3.5% on Friday and are down 15% so far this year.

items.title: 晶片抵押融資重塑AI債務市場！黑石、輝達、博通布局  違約風險升溫
items.title_en: Chip‑Collateral Financing Reshapes AI Debt Market! Blackstone, Nvidia, Broadcom Positioning, Default Risk Rises
paras: 人工智慧（AI）基礎設施投資持續擴大，以晶片作為抵押品的結構性融資正迅速崛起，成為支撐AI產業擴張的重要資金來源。從私募信貸到銀團貸款，華爾街正將GPU及其所產生的算力轉化為可融資資產，相關市場規模有望邁向兆美元級別。不過，隨著資金集中於少數晶片供應商、雲端業者及新興AI公司，一旦AI商業回報不如預期，整條產業鏈恐面臨連鎖衝擊。
這波融資模式的發展可追溯至2023年，當時黑石(BX-US) 向AI雲端服務商CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 提供23億美元私募信貸，開創以晶片作為抵押品的融資先例。
如今，博通(AVGO-US) 正與華爾街機構洽談為Anthropic安排600億美元晶片融資，SpaceX(SPCX-US) 據報也尋求為輝達(NVDA-US) 晶片取得400億美元融資；輝達本身則宣布與六大貸款機構建立總額5,000億美元的合作框架。
摩根大通分析師預估，2030年前晶片支出總額可能超過3兆美元，其中大部分將仰賴舉債支應。

晶片抵押融資興起　CoreWeave開創先例

晶片抵押融資的核心，是透過設立特殊目的公司（SPV）持有晶片，再以客戶合約所產生的現金流償還債務，並讓貸款期限配合晶片約5至6年的折舊週期，將相關資產的折舊風險納入融資安排。
CoreWeave聯合創辦人Brannin McBee回憶，黑石戰術機會團隊最初評估這項業務時，曾對GPU及AI市場的發展前景提出疑問。經過盡職調查後，黑石於2023年主導完成23億美元融資，為後續晶片抵押債務交易建立範例。
這種模式借鑑了商品市場的項目融資經驗，類似液化天然氣產業先取得客戶合約，再為建設設施籌措資金的做法。CoreWeave最初以微軟(MSFT-US) 合約作為融資支撐，當時借款利率高達雙位數中段。
隨著客戶陣容擴大，CoreWeave的融資條件也逐步改善。今年3月，公司以Meta(META-US) 合約為支撐完成85億美元債務融資，借款利率降至約6%。這類交易的關鍵，在於貸款機構更重視客戶的信用評級及合約所提供的保障，而非單純依照CoreWeave自身的垃圾級信用評級定價。

晶片成本高昂　新興AI業者尋求外部資金

AI基礎設施的資本需求，正是這類融資快速成長的主要原因。晶片成本可能是承載晶片的數據中心建設成本的2至4倍，但晶片又會在約5至6年內折舊，使企業必須在短時間內籌措龐大資金。
以AI雲端服務商Nscale在西維吉尼亞州的旗艦計畫為例，配套發電廠預計耗資65億美元，數據中心及設備成本約180億美元，GPU採購支出則高達470億美元。
Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 旗下Google、微軟、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 及Meta等具投資級評級的科技巨頭，能運用充裕現金或相對低成本的債券融資支應硬體採購。但OpenAI、Anthropic及其他新興雲端服務商，未必具備相同的資產負債表實力。
OpenAI財務主管Mike Liberatore指出，當前基礎設施建設規模前所未見，業界缺乏既有模式，可以在高度資本密集的情況下，以傳統方式從零開始發展通用人工智慧（AGI）。
因此，業者開始採用項目融資及結構性融資機制，將個別交易的風險隔離在SPV內，並依據交易本身的資產品質與客戶信用取得融資，而非完全仰賴借款企業自身的信用條件。部分安排也能讓相關債務不直接列入企業本身的資產負債表。

博通、輝達提供信用支持　降低融資成本

隨著交易規模擴大，晶片供應商也開始直接參與融資架構。博通與輝達透過提供信用支持，協助相關債務取得較佳的融資條件。
這類安排通常涉及違約保障：如果借款方違約，晶片可重新出租或出售，用於償還未清償債務；若處分所得不足，晶片供應商則依約填補資金缺口。這種支持機制有助於讓SPV發行的優先級債券取得投資級評級，降低融資成本。
Apollo與黑石近期共同完成一筆350億美元的「Big Sky」交易，為Anthropic提供融資支持。這也是博通、Apollo及黑石共同建立的「AI XPV」平台首筆落地交易。
美國銀行策略師估計，若該平台達到20吉瓦的融資容量，到2029年年中可能需要2,350億美元的背書債務。
在Anthropic這筆交易中，獲得博通信用支持的兩檔優先級債券取得投資級評級，其中最大一檔的利率為5.75%；風險較高的45億美元次級債券，定價利率則為8.5%。相較於Anthropic作為未獲評級的私人企業自行融資，這類安排有望降低借款成本。
今年8月，輝達也集結Apollo、黑石、貝萊德(BLK-US) 、Brookfield、KKR(KKR-US) 及高盛集團(GS-US) ，共同為AI基礎設施提供融資來源。輝達承諾為其中最高25%的融資份額提供信用支持。

融資走向公開市場　投資級評級成關鍵

若要進一步擴大規模，晶片抵押融資必須從私募市場走向銀團貸款，甚至進入投資級公開債券市場。後者是全球規模最大、融資成本相對較低的資本來源之一。
CoreWeave今年率先完成晶片支持的銀團槓桿貸款，兩筆交易均獲機構投資人穩健認購，市場交易價格接近面值，與該公司企業層級的債券表現形成對比。
摩根士丹利結構性產品與私募資本市場全球主管Rich Myers表示，這類融資直接連結具有高度價值的資產，也就是晶片所產生的算力，而市場已有大量跡象顯示，算力需求將持續成長，甚至超過供應。
Apollo全球資產配置主管Chris Edson則指出，傳統公開債務市場無法單獨滿足數位基礎設施龐大的資金需求，必須結合項目融資、私募配售、保險資金及商業不動產等多元資本來源。
在此架構下，取得投資級評級至關重要，因為這有助於交易進入保險資金等大型資本池，進一步降低融資成本並擴大資金供應。

私募交易不透明　AI產業鏈風險升高

不過，晶片抵押融資快速擴張，也使市場對風險集中及流動性的疑慮升高。
Fitch Ratings高級董事Jason Pompeii指出，目前晶片供應商提供融資支持的規模前所未見，風險也高度集中。一旦AI產業的發展未能符合預期，衝擊可能沿著整條供應鏈擴散。
由於多數晶片融資交易屬於私募性質，投資人缺乏公開市場的交易管道，難以在需要時迅速退出。此外，交易將少數晶片供應商、雲端巨頭及新興雲端業者緊密連結，形成高度集中的交叉曝險。
CoreWeave企業層級的垃圾級債券近期大幅下跌，部分價格跌至面值的80%，殖利率攀升至約15%，反映市場對AI商業回報及相關企業償債能力的疑慮。
Magnetar替代信貸與固定收益業務董事總經理Dave Snyderman警告，融資管道可能進一步集中於規模最大的企業，只有少數業者能取得足夠的資金支持。
此外，客戶合約能否在壓力情境下充分保障債權人，也是市場關注的問題。Carlyle資產支持融資主管Akhil Bansal指出，市場普遍假設相關合約具有高度約束力，但若GPU信用支持主要集中於少數機構，這些機構在交易中的議價能力及風險承擔方式，仍值得審慎評估。
Nuveen私募固定收益主管Laura Parrott則表示，目前暫緩參與大型投資級晶片交易，待市場架構更成熟後再重新評估。她指出，這類融資仍屬全新結構，一旦遭遇重大衝擊，市場尚不清楚最終將如何演變。
除了金融風險，基礎設施部署也面臨外部變數。德州地方反對聲浪已促使新計畫暫停，甲骨文(ORCL-US) 在新墨西哥州的項目則因監管障礙而延後付款；OpenAI與Anthropic也正就安全問題討論放慢部署步調。

算力有望成為新型資產類別

儘管風險仍待釐清，金融機構對晶片抵押融資的長期發展仍抱持期待。
黑石戰術機會團隊高級董事總經理John Watson將目前的發展階段比作汽車產業早期。當年汽車金融同樣面臨市場對產品需求的疑問，但隨著汽車普及，相關融資逐漸發展成規模龐大且成熟的市場。
在晶片資產價值方面，早期研究及實際使用數據顯示，晶片的實際使用壽命可能超過目前會計處理所反映的年限，有助於改善其融資條件。
美國銀行基礎設施與永續融資全球主管Karen Fang預期，市場未來可能出現類似二手車價格指南的半導體估值工具，進而帶動晶片租賃及避險市場發展。
Watson認為，長期目標是將算力轉化為能在全球市場交易及融資的資產類別，讓金融市場依據算力的經濟價值提供資金。
不過，這套融資模式能否持續擴張，最終仍取決於AI商業化能否實現市場預期。
paras_en: AI infrastructure investment continues to expand, and structured financing that uses chips as collateral is rapidly emerging as a key source of capital to support the industry's growth. From private credit to syndicated loans, Wall Street is turning GPUs and the compute power they generate into financable assets, with the market potentially reaching a trillion‑dollar scale. However, as funding concentrates among a few chip makers, cloud providers and emerging AI firms, a weaker‑than‑expected AI commercial return could trigger a chain reaction across the entire supply chain.
The financing model dates back to 2023, when Blackstone (BX‑US) provided a $2.3 billion private‑credit facility to AI cloud provider CoreWeave (CRWV‑US), creating the first chip‑collateral loan.

Today, Broadcom (AVGO‑US) is negotiating a $60 billion chip financing package for Anthropic, SpaceX (SPCX‑US) is reported to be seeking $40 billion of financing for Nvidia (NVDA‑US) chips, and Nvidia itself announced a $500 billion financing framework with six major lenders.
JPMorgan analysts estimate that total chip spending could exceed $3 trillion by 2030, with most of it financed through debt.

Chip‑collateral financing works by setting up a special‑purpose vehicle (SPV) that holds the chips and uses cash flows from customer contracts to repay the debt, aligning loan terms with the chips’ 5‑ to 6‑year depreciation schedule and embedding asset depreciation risk into the financing structure.

CoreWeave co‑founder Brannin McBee recalled that Blackstone’s Tactical Opportunities team initially questioned the outlook for GPUs and the AI market. After due diligence, Blackstone led a $2.3 billion financing in 2023, establishing a template for subsequent chip‑collateral debt deals.

The model borrows from project‑finance practices in commodity markets, similar to how LNG projects first secure customer contracts before raising construction capital. CoreWeave initially relied on a Microsoft (MSFT‑US) contract for financing, with loan rates in the mid‑double‑digit range.

As its customer base grew, CoreWeave’s financing terms improved. In March, the company completed an $8.5 billion debt raise backed by a Meta (META‑US) contract, cutting the loan rate to roughly 6%. The key is that lenders price the loan based on the credit quality of the contracts and customers, not solely on CoreWeave’s junk‑rated credit.

The high cost of chips drives the rapid growth of this financing. Chip expenses can be two to four times the cost of building the data center that houses them, yet the chips depreciate over about five to six years, forcing companies to raise large sums of capital quickly.

For example, AI cloud provider Nscale’s flagship project in West Virginia includes a power plant costing $6.5 billion, data‑center and equipment costs of about $18 billion, and GPU procurement spending of $47 billion.

Tech giants with investment‑grade ratings such as Alphabet’s Google, Microsoft, Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Meta can use abundant cash or relatively cheap bond financing for hardware purchases. Emerging players like OpenAI, Anthropic and other cloud services lack comparable balance‑sheet strength.

OpenAI CFO Mike Liberatore noted that the scale of infrastructure build‑out is unprecedented and that there is no existing model for funding such capital‑intensive development of artificial general intelligence (AGI) from scratch.

Consequently, firms are turning to project‑finance and structured‑finance mechanisms that isolate individual transaction risk within SPVs, obtaining funding based on the transaction’s asset quality and customer credit rather than the borrower’s own credit. Some arrangements also keep the debt off the borrower’s balance sheet.
As deal sizes grow, chip suppliers are joining the financing structures directly. Broadcom and Nvidia provide credit support to help the related debt achieve better financing terms.

These arrangements typically include default protection: if the borrower defaults, the chips can be re‑leased or sold to repay outstanding debt; if proceeds fall short, the chip supplier fills the gap as agreed. This support enables senior bonds issued by the SPV to earn investment‑grade ratings, lowering financing costs.
Apollo and Blackstone recently completed a $35 billion “Big Sky” transaction to fund Anthropic, the first deal under the “AI XPV” platform jointly built by Broadcom, Apollo and Blackstone.
Bank of America strategists estimate that if the platform reaches a 20‑gigawatt financing capacity, it could require $235 billion of backed debt by mid‑2029.

In the Anthropic deal, two senior bonds backed by Broadcom’s credit received investment‑grade ratings, with the larger issue priced at a 5.75% yield; a riskier $4.5 billion subordinated bond was priced at 8.5%. Compared with Anthropic’s un‑rated private financing, this structure should reduce borrowing costs.

In August, Nvidia assembled a financing consortium that includes Apollo, Blackstone, BlackRock (BLK‑US), Brookfield, KKR (KKR‑US) and Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) to fund AI infrastructure, with Nvidia pledging credit support for up to 25% of the financing tranche.

To scale further, chip‑collateral financing must move from private markets to syndicated loans and eventually to investment‑grade public bonds, which represent the world’s largest and lowest‑cost source of capital.

CoreWeave this year became the first to complete a chip‑backed syndicated leveraged loan, with both tranches receiving strong institutional demand and trading near par, contrasting with the company’s corporate‑level bond performance.

Rich Myers, global head of structured products and private‑capital markets at Morgan Stanley, said the financing directly links to high‑value assets—the compute power generated by chips—and market signals show that demand for compute will keep growing, potentially outpacing supply.

Chris Edson, global head of asset allocation at Apollo, noted that traditional public debt markets cannot alone meet the massive funding needs of digital infrastructure; a mix of project finance, private placements, insurance capital and commercial real estate will be required.
Within this framework, achieving an investment‑grade rating is crucial because it allows transactions to tap large insurance‑capital pools, further lowering costs and expanding funding supply.
However, the rapid expansion of chip‑collateral financing raises concerns about risk concentration and liquidity.

Jason Pompeii, senior director at Fitch Ratings, warned that the scale of credit support from chip suppliers is unprecedented and highly concentrated. If AI industry growth falls short of expectations, shocks could ripple through the entire supply chain.

Because most chip‑financing deals are private, investors lack public‑market exit channels, making rapid liquidation difficult. Moreover, the deals tightly link a few chip makers, cloud giants and emerging cloud providers, creating a highly concentrated cross‑exposure.

CoreWeave’s corporate‑level junk bonds have recently slumped, with some trading at 80% of par and yields climbing to about 15%, reflecting market worries about AI commercial returns and the issuers’ ability to service debt.

Dave Snyderman, managing director of alternative credit and fixed‑income at Magnetar, warned that financing channels may become even more concentrated among the largest firms, leaving only a handful able to secure sufficient capital support.

Another market focus is whether customer contracts can fully protect creditors under stress. Akhil Bansal, head of asset‑backed finance at Carlyle, said the market generally assumes contracts are highly enforceable, but if GPU credit support is concentrated in a few institutions, their bargaining power and risk‑bearing approach merit careful scrutiny.

Laura Parrott, head of private‑credit fixed income at Nuveen, said her firm is currently pausing participation in large investment‑grade chip deals until the market structure matures. She added that these financings are brand‑new structures, and it is unclear how they would evolve after a major shock.

Beyond financial risk, infrastructure deployment faces external variables. Opposition in Texas has halted new projects, Oracle’s (ORCL‑US) New Mexico site has been delayed by regulatory hurdles, and OpenAI and Anthropic are discussing slower roll‑outs over safety concerns.
Despite unresolved risks, financial institutions remain optimistic about the long‑term prospects of chip‑collateral financing.

John Watson, senior managing director of Blackstone’s Tactical Opportunities team, likened the current stage to the early automobile industry, which also faced demand uncertainty before financing grew into a massive, mature market.
Early research and usage data suggest that chips’ actual service lives may exceed the periods reflected in current accounting treatment, which could improve their financing terms.

Karen Fang, global head of infrastructure and sustainable finance at Bank of America, expects the market may eventually develop a semiconductor valuation tool akin to used‑car price guides, spurring growth in chip leasing and hedging markets.

Watson believes the long‑term goal is to turn compute power into an asset class that can be traded and financed globally, allowing financial markets to provide capital based on the economic value of compute.
However, whether this financing model can continue to expand ultimately depends on whether AI commercialization meets market expectations.

items.title: 沙烏地攔截胡塞飛彈！川普威脅再次對伊朗發動軍事行動、美伊衝突升溫推高油價
items.title_en: Saudi Arabia Intercepts Houthi Missile! Trump Threatens New Military Action Against Iran, US‑Iran Tensions Lift Oil Prices
paras: 中東局勢再度升溫，沙烏地阿拉伯周六（24日）攔截一枚以首都利雅德為目標的胡塞組織彈道飛彈。隨著美國總統川普再度威脅對伊朗採取軍事行動，加上區域攻擊持續，市場對衝突擴大的憂慮升高，國際油價也大幅上揚。
根據《Investing.com》報導，由沙烏地阿拉伯領導的聯軍表示，利雅德、奈季蘭及瓦迪達瓦西爾發布緊急警報後，防空系統成功摧毀該枚飛彈。當局隨後宣布危險解除。
聯軍另稱，在沙烏地東部省上空攔截一架無人機；與胡塞組織有關的媒體則報導，葉門薩達省再度遭到空襲。
這波區域安全事件發生之際，川普警告華府可能再次對伊朗發動軍事行動，並提及今年2月展開的「史詩怒火行動」（Operation Epic Fury）。
美國駐土耳其大使Tom Barrack另表示，攻擊行動最快可能在本周末發生，但川普隨後表示，他對這類計畫一無所知。
不斷升高的軍事威脅已對能源市場造成明顯衝擊。布蘭特原油周五（23日）升至每桶117.30美元，美國西德州中級原油則漲至每桶103美元，市場擔憂能源供應可能受到干擾。
根據《路透》報導所引用的華盛頓研究所數據，若以已確認的攻擊次數衡量，10月也已成為荷姆茲海峽商業航運安全情勢最嚴峻的月份，迄今至少有28起船舶遇襲事件。
該研究所統計，自2月以來，相關攻擊事件已累計113起；國際海事組織（IMO）記錄的事件則達120起。
美國駐聯合國大使Mike Waltz表示，華府可能在可預見的未來持續對伊朗實施海上封鎖。
儘管軍事威脅升高，外交努力仍在進行。國際原子能總署（IAEA）署長Rafael Grossi表示，該機構在技術上已準備好恢復對伊朗核計畫的查核工作，並強調有必要透過談判達成協議。
伊朗常駐聯合國副代表則表示，德黑蘭並未放棄履行核子保障義務，但也以安全疑慮為由，說明核查人員返回伊朗面臨的問題。
伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚（Masoud Pezeshkian）預計下周在莫斯科出席天然氣出口國峰會期間，與俄羅斯總統普丁會面。
另一邊，以色列在約旦河西岸的軍事與安全措施也進一步升級。一場發生在希伯崙附近的槍擊事件造成兩名以色列士兵死亡後，以色列對遭占領的約旦河西岸實施大範圍限制。
以色列總理納坦雅胡（Benjamin Netanyahu）揚言展開大規模軍事行動，以軍則持續在當地進行突襲與拆除行動。
paras_en: Middle‑East tensions rose again on Saturday (the 24th) when Saudi Arabia intercepted a Houthi ballistic missile aimed at the capital Riyadh. As former U.S. President Donald Trump again threatened military action against Iran and regional attacks continued, market worries about a widening conflict grew, sending international oil prices sharply higher.

According to Investing.com, the Saudi‑led coalition said that after emergency alerts were issued in Riyadh, Najran and Wadi ad‑Dawasir, the air‑defence system successfully destroyed the missile. Authorities later announced that the danger had been cleared.
The coalition also reported that a drone was intercepted over the eastern province of Saudi Arabia; Houthi‑linked media said Yemen’s Saada province was hit by another air strike.
The regional security incidents came as Trump warned that Washington could launch another military operation against Iran, citing the “Operation Epic Fury” that began in February this year.
U.S. ambassador to Turkey Tom Barrack added that an attack could occur as early as this weekend, but Trump later said he knew nothing about such plans.

The rising military threat has visibly impacted energy markets. Brent crude rose on Friday the 23rd to $117.30 a barrel, while U.S. West Texas Intermediate climbed to $103 a barrel, as markets fear possible disruptions to energy supplies.

Reuters, citing data from the Washington Institute, reported that October has already become the most dangerous month for commercial shipping in the Hormuz Strait, with at least 28 vessel‑attack incidents recorded so far.
The institute’s statistics show that since February there have been 113 related attacks; the International Maritime Organization (IMO) has logged 120 incidents.
U.S. ambassador to the United Nations Mike Waltz said Washington may continue to impose a maritime blockade on Iran in the foreseeable future.

Despite the heightened military threat, diplomatic efforts continue. IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi said the agency is technically ready to resume inspections of Iran’s nuclear program and stressed the need to reach an agreement through negotiations.
Iran’s deputy UN representative said Tehran has not abandoned its nuclear safeguard obligations but cited security concerns that make it difficult for inspectors to return to Iran.
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian is expected to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin next week in Moscow during the natural‑gas exporters summit.

Meanwhile, Israel has further escalated its military and security measures in the West Bank. After a shooting near Hebron that killed two Israeli soldiers, Israel imposed broad restrictions on the occupied West Bank.
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu warned of a large‑scale military operation, and the Israeli army continues raids and demolition activities in the area.

items.title: 法國繃緊神經迎新一波示威 7萬維安人力出動 精品店封窗、羅浮宮閉館
items.title_en: France Tightens Security Ahead of New Wave of Protests, Deploys 70,000 Security Personnel; Boutique Windows Boarded, Louvre Closed
paras: 法國週六(24日)迎來新一波示威，引發外界憂心上週末的暴亂恐再度上演。
法國內政部長努涅茲（Laurent Nunez）週五向記者表示，政府誓言遏止任何暴力行為，將部署7萬名維安人員，包括反恐精銳部隊。他指控極左派透過社群媒體號召暴力行動。
巴黎商家，包括精品店，已用木板封住櫥窗並增聘保全，部分店家將暫停營業。羅浮宮、奧賽美術館及畢卡索美術館等三座熱門博物館，週六也將閉館。原定在巴黎舉行的巴黎聖日耳曼對里昂足球賽則已延期。
努涅茲表示：「對於滋事者、搶劫者及任何施暴者，包括極左派政治團體，我們絕不妥協。」
他強調，警方已準備好應對暴亂。軍方將協助守衛敏感建築，直升機、水砲車及名為「半人馬」（Centaurs）的裝甲車也將待命。里昂等部分城市已禁止週六舉行示威，並延長宵禁。
民怨指向馬克宏 極右派支持度受惠
法國總統馬克宏週四承認，上週末的維安部署存在「規劃疏失與始料未及的狀況」。當時逾50萬人上街抗議，示威隨後演變成破壞行動，暴徒在全國各地攻擊公共建築、洗劫商店。
馬克宏已延後原定的西非訪問行程，並指控極左派團體發動他所稱的煽動叛亂行為。
週六的示威獲得社群媒體人士、學生、工會及左派政黨等不同群體支持，被定位為這場運動的「第二幕」（Acte II），訴求包括改善公共服務，以及要求政府協助民眾因應生活成本。
大部分怒火指向馬克宏；距離第二任期結束僅剩六個月，他的民意支持度已跌至歷來最低。
民調顯示，暴力事件有利於極右派候選人雷朋（Marine Le Pen），她目前在明年大選中居於領先。雷朋週六將在法國中部城市奧爾良召集數千名支持者，出席國民聯盟黨代表大會，反對她的群眾也將前往抗議，進一步加劇緊張情勢。
財政疑慮升溫 法德公債利差擴大
這波動盪也加深外界對法國公共財政的疑慮。雖然法國週五晚間躲過穆迪信評降評，但在2027年大選前，仍難以縮減預算赤字。
一項備受關注的債券風險指標已升至歐債危機以來未見的水準。法國與被視為歐洲安全資產的德國10年期公債殖利率差，週四擴大至178個基點，遠高於9月初的85個基點。
法國民間企業經濟活動本月也陷入萎縮。標普全球編製的綜合採購經理人指數（PMI），由上月的51.1降至10月的48.4，跌破區分景氣擴張與萎縮的50榮枯線。
歐洲多國也面臨抗議潮
法國並非唯一面臨民眾動盪的歐洲國家。義大利米蘭與羅馬預計週末將出現學生及其他青年發起的示威。米蘭上週末的抗議演變成搶劫與暴亂後，義大利政府表示將派遣軍隊進駐。
比利時也預計出現抗議活動；阿爾巴尼亞則因民眾不滿總理拉瑪（Edi Rama）的執政，由學生主導的暴力示威已進入第二週。
paras_en: France on Saturday (the 24th) faced a new wave of demonstrations, raising concerns that the riots of last weekend could recur.

Interior Minister Laurent Nunez told reporters on Friday that the government is determined to curb any violence, deploying 70,000 security personnel, including elite anti‑terror units. He accused far‑left groups of using social media to call for violent actions.

Paris merchants, including boutique owners, have boarded up shop windows with wooden planks and hired extra security, with some stores suspending operations. The Louvre, the Musée d'Orsay and the Musée Picasso will also be closed on Saturday, and the scheduled Paris Saint‑Germain versus Lyon football match has been postponed.
Nunez said, "We will not compromise with troublemakers, looters or any perpetrators of violence, including far‑left political groups."

He stressed that police are ready to handle riots. The military will help guard sensitive buildings, with helicopters, water‑cannon trucks and armored vehicles called "Centaurs" on standby. Cities such as Lyon have banned Saturday demonstrations and extended curfews.
Public discontent is turning against President Macron, boosting support for the far‑right.

President Emmanuel Macron admitted on Thursday that the security deployment last weekend suffered from "planning oversights and unforeseen circumstances." More than 500,000 people took to the streets, and the protests later turned into vandalism, with rioters attacking public buildings and looting shops across the country.
Macron has postponed his planned visit to West Africa and accused far‑left groups of inciting what he called a rebellion.

Saturday's protest draws support from social‑media users, students, unions and left‑wing parties and is framed as the "Acte II" of the movement, demanding better public services and government help with the cost of living.
Most of the anger is aimed at Macron; with only six months left in his second term, his approval rating has fallen to a historic low.

Polls show that the violence is benefiting far‑right candidate Marine Le Pen, who currently leads in next year’s election. Le Pen will rally thousands of supporters in Orléans on Saturday for a National Rally party congress, while opposing crowds are expected to protest, further heightening tensions.
Fiscal concerns rise as the France‑Germany sovereign‑bond yield spread widens
The turmoil deepens doubts about France’s public finances. Although Moody’s avoided a downgrade on Friday night, trimming the budget deficit before the 2027 election remains difficult.

A key bond‑risk indicator has risen to its highest level since the Euro‑zone debt crisis. The spread between French and German 10‑year government bond yields widened to 178 basis points on Thursday, up from 85 basis points in early September.

French private‑sector activity also contracted this month. S&P Global’s composite Purchasing Managers' Index fell from 51.1 last month to 48.4 in October, slipping below the 50 threshold that separates expansion from contraction.
Several European nations also face protest waves

France is not the only European country dealing with public unrest. Italy’s Milan and Rome are expected to see student‑led and youth demonstrations this weekend. After Milan’s protests turned into robberies and riots last weekend, the Italian government said it will deploy troops.
Belgium is also expected to see protests, and in Albania, violent student‑led demonstrations against Prime Minister Edi Rama’s government have entered a second week.

items.title: Anthropic會延後「超級IPO」嗎？AI股回檔添變數、時程相當緊迫
items.title_en: Will Anthropic Delay Its "Super IPO"? AI Stocks Pull Back Adds Uncertainty, Timeline Very Tight
paras: 人工智慧（AI）新創公司Anthropic傳出計畫於11月中旬完成首次公開發行（IPO），目標估值高達2兆美元，有望成為史上規模最大的科技IPO之一。不過，近期AI概念股遭遇賣壓，加上美國證券交易委員會（SEC）對招股文件公開時間的要求，讓Anthropic的上市時程面臨壓力。
根據《路透》報導，依規定，公司必須在上市路演開始至少15天前公開提交招股說明書（S-1文件），因此若要趕上原定時程，留給Anthropic準備的時間已相當有限。
若Anthropic以2兆美元估值上市，規模將超越SpaceX(SPCX-US) 今年稍早1.77兆美元的上市規模。
與此同時，市場近期對AI產業支出能否持續的疑慮也持續升高。新興雲端運算公司CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 股價在兩周內下跌約30%，記憶體大廠美光科技(MU-US) 近一個月則下跌17%。
市場人士認為，這波回檔可能影響Anthropic的上市決策，但公司對資金的需求，也可能促使其繼續推進IPO計畫。
預測市場目前估計，Anthropic年底前上市的機率約為80%。
佛羅里達大學IPO研究計畫負責人Jay Ritter表示，若Anthropic希望在感恩節前完成上市，時間仍然充裕，但時程已相當緊迫。
若公司將IPO日期訂在最晚11月24日，並於11月16日啟動路演，就必須在下周末前公開提交S-1文件。
Anthropic先前原本被預期會在美國勞工節後不久公開招股說明書，市場當時一度預估公司可能於9月下旬掛牌，但最終並未如期推進。

AI股遭拋售　市場憂支出與融資前景

根據《MarketWatch》報導，近期AI相關股票大幅修正，是Anthropic管理層必須納入考量的重要因素。
因市場擔憂CoreWeave債務管理能力，該公司股價兩周內下跌約30%；美光近一個月跌幅則達17%，反映投資人對AI支出規模及融資前景的疑慮升溫。
Rational Equity Armor Fund投資組合經理Joe Tigay也指出，持續的通膨壓力與高漲的能源價格同樣令人擔憂。
他認為，從歷史經驗來看，經濟成長放緩與通膨並存，往往是股市出現問題的前兆。若相關壓力持續累積，Anthropic可能選擇暫緩上市，留在私人市場等待更有利的時機。
不過，也有市場人士認為，Anthropic成功上市有助於重振投資人對AI產業的信心。
Cerity Partners首席市場策略師Jim Lebenthal表示，市場近期對AI產業的長期發展潛力與商業模式提出更多質疑，因此需要一場成功的Anthropic IPO，證明AI產業具備持續發展的能力。
他指出，市場提出疑問甚至產生懷疑並不為過，但美國股市與整體經濟的健康，在很大程度上仍取決於AI產業能否成功。

AI算力支出龐大　資金需求成上市推力

分析指出，除了市場環境，Anthropic自身對資金的迫切需求，也可能是推動公司如期上市的關鍵因素。
Zacks Investment Research股票策略師Andrew Rocco表示，大型AI公司已展現出願意大規模投入資金的態度，希望藉此吸引更多用戶，並爭取成為市場主導者。
他認為，Anthropic將努力推進IPO，因為公司確實需要這筆資金，尤其當私人市場融資可能變得更加困難時，上市將成為重要的資金來源。
根據《華爾街日報》報導，Anthropic的招股說明書草案顯示，公司未來數年在AI算力方面的支出可能高達7,500億美元。
此外，草案顯示，Anthropic在2026年上半年錄得逾800億美元淨虧損，營收則為163億美元。報導指出，這筆虧損主要來自會計調整，而非基本業務狀況惡化。
paras_en: AI startup Anthropic is reported to plan completing its initial public offering (IPO) in mid‑November, targeting a valuation of up to $2 trillion, which could make it one of the largest tech IPOs ever. However, recent selling pressure on AI‑related stocks and the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission’s (SEC) timing requirements for filing prospectuses are putting pressure on Anthropic’s listing schedule.

According to Reuters, regulations require a company to publicly file its S‑1 registration statement at least 15 days before the start of the road‑show. That leaves Anthropic very little time to prepare if it wants to stick to the original timetable.
If Anthropic lists at a $2 trillion valuation, its size would surpass SpaceX (SPCX‑US), which earlier this year went public at $1.77 trillion.

At the same time, market doubts about whether AI‑industry spending can be sustained are rising. Emerging cloud‑computing firm CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) has seen its share price fall about 30% over two weeks, and memory‑chip giant Micron Technology (MU‑US) has dropped 17% in the past month.
Market participants think this pull‑back could affect Anthropic’s IPO decision, but the company’s need for capital may also push it to continue with the offering plan.
Current market forecasts estimate roughly an 80% chance that Anthropic will go public before the end of the year.

Jay Ritter, head of the University of Florida’s IPO research project, said that if Anthropic wants to complete the listing before Thanksgiving, there is still time, but the schedule is extremely tight.
If the company sets the latest IPO date for November 24 and starts the road‑show on November 16, it must file the S‑1 publicly by the weekend before next week.
Anthropic had originally been expected to file its prospectus shortly after U.S. Labor Day, and the market at that time briefly expected a late‑September listing, but that timeline was not met.
AI stocks are being sold off, and market worries about spending and financing outlooks are key considerations for Anthropic’s management, according to MarketWatch.

Because the market is concerned about CoreWeave’s debt‑management ability, its shares have fallen about 30% in two weeks; Micron’s one‑month decline of 17% reflects rising investor anxiety over AI spending levels and financing prospects.
Joe Tigay, portfolio manager of the Rational Equity Armor Fund, also noted that persistent inflation pressure and high energy prices are cause for concern.

He believes that historically, a slowdown in economic growth combined with inflation often precedes stock‑market trouble. If those pressures continue to build, Anthropic may choose to postpone its listing and stay private until conditions improve.
However, some market participants argue that a successful Anthropic IPO would help revive investor confidence in the AI sector.

Jim Lebenthal, chief market strategist at Cerity Partners, said that recent doubts about the AI industry’s long‑term potential and business models mean a successful Anthropic IPO is needed to prove the sector’s ability to sustain growth.
He added that questioning and even skepticism about the industry are understandable, but the health of U.S. equities and the broader economy largely depends on whether AI can succeed.
Massive AI compute spending and funding needs are driving forces behind the IPO push, analysts note, alongside market conditions.
Andrew Rocco, stock strategist at Zacks Investment Research, said large AI firms have shown a willingness to invest heavily to attract users and aim for market leadership.
He believes Anthropic will push ahead with the IPO because it truly needs the capital, especially as private‑market financing may become harder, making the public market an important source of funds.
A draft of Anthropic’s prospectus, reported by the Wall Street Journal, shows the company could spend as much as $750 billion on AI compute over the next several years.

The draft also shows Anthropic recorded a net loss of over $80 billion in the first half of 2026, with revenue of $16.3 billion. The report notes the loss is mainly due to accounting adjustments rather than a deterioration of core business conditions.

items.title: 為川金會暖身？金正恩再訪中國 時機引關注
items.title_en: Warming Up for Trump? Kim Jong Un Returns to China, Timing Draws Attention
paras: 北韓最高領導人金正恩已抵達中國丹東，這是他一年多來第二度訪中，時間點落在美國總統川普下月前往亞洲之前。
一名南韓政府官員表示，金正恩似乎是經由新鴨綠江大橋抵達丹東。這座橋是過去一個月內啟用的兩座主要橋梁之一，兩座橋分別連接北韓與其重要貿易夥伴中國及俄羅斯。
金正恩曾於2025年9月前往北京出席大型閱兵典禮，中國國家主席習近平則於同年6月訪問北韓。這兩個傳統盟邦近來積極深化雙邊關係，包括恢復首都之間的鐵路與航班服務。
川普先前曾表達今年與金正恩會面的意願，但隨後降溫了外界對雙邊峰會的預期。川普原先計畫於11月前往中國深圳出席亞太經濟合作會議（APEC）峰會期間，為雙方舉行面會開啟大門。
國際危機組織資深顧問格林（Christopher Green）表示：「金正恩可能是為了在同意與川普會面前，先與習近平協調立場，這符合2018至2019年的先例。不過，除了對美外交，金正恩與中國還有許多議題可談，未來一兩天，議程應會逐漸明朗。」
共同社報導，金正恩此行可能包括出席中國在韓戰期間出兵援助北韓的76週年紀念活動。
paras_en: North Korea’s supreme leader Kim Jong Un has arrived in Dandong, China, marking his second visit to the country in just over a year, and coming just before U.S. President Trump’s scheduled trip to Asia next month.

A South Korean government official said Kim appears to have entered Dandong via the New Yalu River Bridge. The bridge is one of two major crossings that were opened in the past month, linking North Korea with its key trading partners China and Russia.

Kim previously traveled to Beijing in September 2025 to attend a large military parade, while Chinese President Xi Jinping visited North Korea in June of the same year. The two traditional allies have recently been deepening bilateral ties, including restoring rail and flight services between their capitals.

Trump had earlier expressed a willingness to meet Kim this year, but that softened expectations for a bilateral summit. Trump originally planned to travel to Shenzhen, China, in November for the APEC summit and to use the occasion for a face‑to‑face meeting.

Christopher Green, a senior adviser at the International Crisis Group, said, “Kim may be coordinating his stance with Xi before agreeing to meet Trump, following the precedent set in 2018‑2019. However, beyond U.S. diplomacy, Kim has many issues to discuss with China, and the agenda should become clearer over the next day or two.”
According to Kyodo News, Kim’s trip may also include attending the 76th‑anniversary commemoration of China’s military assistance to North Korea during the Korean War.

items.title: Meta探索AI變現新路：Muse不放廣告、購物抽成與企業服務收費
items.title_en: Meta Explores New AI Monetization Paths: Muse Free of Ads, Shopping Commissions, and Enterprise Service Fees
paras: Meta(META-US) 正為人工智慧（AI）業務開拓廣告以外的收入來源。Meta首席AI長Alexandr Wang表示，個人AI代理Muse將維持免廣告，一般用戶可免費使用，高階功能則採訂閱制，並規劃推出企業付費服務，以及從AI代理促成的購物交易中收取佣金。
Wang接受《日經新聞》訪問時指出，Muse不僅能回答問題，還能代替使用者執行任務，協助節省時間與金錢，因此比先前的AI產品更實用。
Muse於9月8日在北美上線，六週內應用程式下載量達到1,000萬次，成長速度超越包括ChatGPT在內的部分競爭產品，並於10月23日首度進軍日本市場。
免費吸引用戶 高階功能採訂閱制
Meta希望未來將Muse推廣至數十億用戶，目前對一般使用者免費開放，並已針對重度用戶及希望使用最先進模型的用戶推出訂閱方案。此外，公司也計劃提供企業付費服務，但尚未揭露具體收費標準與推出時間。
與Meta旗下社群平台仰賴廣告的營運模式不同，Wang明確表示：「Muse內部沒有廣告，我們也沒有投放廣告的計畫。」這意味著，按照目前規劃，Meta不會直接在Muse的互動介面置入廣告。
對廣告收入占比超過95%的Meta而言，Muse提供了探索其他收入來源的機會。隨著產品拓展至更多市場，加上公司持續斥資建設AI基礎設施，如何將用戶成長轉化為可持續的收入，成為市場關注焦點。
AI代理協助購物 Meta規劃抽佣
除了個人訂閱與企業服務，Meta也計劃從用戶透過AI代理完成的購物交易中抽取佣金，讓Muse的應用從資訊查詢、任務協助延伸至購物。
這項模式可望為Meta帶來廣告以外的交易收入，但實際執行方式仍待釐清。公司尚未公布佣金比例、適用商家範圍與正式推出時間。
未來能創造多少收入，將取決於Muse執行任務的能力、商家串接情況，以及使用者是否願意將購物決策交給AI代理。
擴大基礎建設 支撐產品發展
Wang認為，Meta自有的技術基礎設施、安全體系與資料中心，是競爭對手難以複製的重要優勢。個人AI代理需要執行任務、處理使用者資訊並串接不同服務，除了模型能力，基礎設施的規模、可靠性與安全性也相當重要。
Meta週三(21日)於美股盤後公布財報時，將2026年資本支出預估區間調整為1,350億至1,450億美元，下限較先前提高50億美元。
公司22日提交的監管文件另顯示，截至9月底，尚未開始履行的租賃義務與不可撤銷合約承諾合計約8,100億美元。若納入最高約147億美元的或有雲端運算容量採購義務，未來承諾投入總額接近8,250億美元。
上述投入除支援Meta現有業務，也將用於新一代AI模型與產品開發。龐大的基礎建設能否提升產品能力，進而帶動訂閱、企業服務與交易佣金收入，將是Muse商業化進展的關鍵。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) is seeking revenue streams beyond advertising for its artificial intelligence (AI) business. Meta’s chief AI officer Alexandr Wang said the personal AI agent Muse will remain ad‑free, with general users able to use it for free, while premium features will be subscription‑based. The company also plans to launch paid enterprise services and to take a commission on shopping transactions facilitated by the AI agent.

In an interview with the Nikkei, Wang noted that Muse not only answers questions but can also perform tasks on behalf of users, helping them save time and money, making it more practical than previous AI products.

Muse launched in North America on September 8 and amassed 10 million app downloads within six weeks, growing faster than several competing products including ChatGPT, and entered the Japanese market for the first time on October 23.
Free to attract users, premium features subscription‑based

Meta hopes to eventually roll Muse out to billions of users. It is currently free for ordinary users, and a subscription plan has been introduced for heavy users and those who want access to the most advanced models. The company also plans to offer paid enterprise services, though it has not disclosed pricing or rollout timing.

Unlike Meta’s ad‑driven social platforms, Wang made it clear: “There are no ads inside Muse, and we have no plans to run ads.” This means that, under current plans, Meta will not place advertisements directly in Muse’s interaction interface.

For Meta, whose ad revenue accounts for more than 95% of its income, Muse offers an opportunity to explore other revenue sources. As the product expands into more markets and the company continues to invest heavily in AI infrastructure, the question of how to turn user growth into sustainable revenue has become a focal point for the market.
AI agent assists shopping, Meta plans commissions

In addition to personal subscriptions and enterprise services, Meta also plans to take a commission on shopping transactions completed by users through the AI agent, extending Muse’s use from information lookup and task assistance to commerce.

This model could generate transaction revenue for Meta beyond advertising, but the exact implementation details remain unclear. The company has not disclosed the commission rate, the range of applicable merchants, or the official launch date.

How much revenue it can eventually generate will depend on Muse’s task‑execution capabilities, merchant integration, and whether users are willing to entrust their purchasing decisions to an AI agent.
Expanding infrastructure to support product development

Wang believes Meta’s own technology infrastructure, security systems, and data centers constitute a significant advantage that rivals cannot easily replicate. A personal AI agent must execute tasks, process user data, and connect to various services; beyond model capability, the scale, reliability, and security of the underlying infrastructure are equally critical.

When Meta reported earnings after the U.S. market close on Wednesday (the 21st), it revised its 2026 capital‑expenditure outlook to a range of $135 billion to $145 billion, raising the lower end by $5 billion from its prior estimate.

Regulatory filings submitted on the 22nd show that as of the end of September, unfulfilled lease obligations and irrevocable contract commitments total about $810 billion. Including up to roughly $14.7 billion of potential cloud‑computing capacity purchase obligations, the total future commitment approaches $825 billion.

These investments will support Meta’s existing businesses as well as the development of next‑generation AI models and products. Whether the massive infrastructure boost can enhance product capabilities and drive subscription, enterprise service, and transaction‑commission revenue will be key to Muse’s commercialization progress.

items.title: 阿拉斯加LNG開發案遭爆獲俄國受制裁企業融資！Novatek涉入營運引發合規疑慮
items.title_en: Alaska LNG Project Faces Financing from Sanctioned Russian Firm; Novatek Involvement Raises Compliance Concerns
paras: 傳阿拉斯加液化天然氣（LNG）開發案涉及受美國制裁的俄羅斯能源巨頭Novatek PJSC，引發外界對制裁合規問題的關注。
根據《金融時報》報導，Polar Train LNG前執行長Joel Riddle指出，Novatek曾向Polar Train LNG的開發計畫提供資金，並在取得美國財政部必要許可前介入項目營運。
《金融時報》及《紐約時報》另一篇報導指出，Riddle上月辭職，隨後另有多名高階主管離任。
不過，Polar LNG周五（23日）發布聲明反駁，稱Riddle是「心懷不滿的前員工」，且已遭公司解雇。公司強調，開發工作均依照美國適用法律進行。
根據該聲明，Polar LNG已向美國財政部海外資產控制辦公室（OFAC）提出許可申請，尋求取得向Novatek購買一座尚未完工的重力式結構的許可。該結構是液化天然氣設施的一部分。
《金融時報》引述Novatek聲明指出，該公司已於今年4月與Polar Train簽署諒解備忘錄，並表示，要執行如此大規模的項目，仍須取得美國與俄羅斯主管機關的必要批准。
美國財政部官員則表示，該部門不會針對違反制裁規定的指控發表評論，但會「極其嚴肅地看待」任何潛在違規行為。
另一方面，Polar Train LNG的營運公司已任命前高盛俄羅斯銀行執行長Tim Talkington出任代理執行長。公司聲明指出，Talkington目前也是母公司Polar Eagle LNG的總裁。
Polar LNG的目標是在2030年底前，開始從阿拉斯加北坡輸送天然氣。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: It is reported that the Alaska liquefied natural gas (LNG) development project involves Russia’s energy giant Novatek PJSC, which is under U.S. sanctions, sparking concerns about sanctions compliance.

According to the Financial Times, former Polar Train LNG CEO Joel Riddle said Novatek had provided funding for Polar Train LNG’s development plan and entered the project’s operations before obtaining the necessary U.S. Treasury permission.
The Financial Times and another New York Times report noted that Riddle resigned last month, and several other senior executives have also left their positions.

However, Polar LNG issued a statement on Friday (the 23rd) denying the allegations, describing Riddle as a "disgruntled former employee" who had been terminated by the company, and emphasizing that the development work is being carried out in compliance with applicable U.S. law.

The statement said Polar LNG has applied to the U.S. Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) for a license to purchase an unfinished gravity‑based structure from Novatek, a component of the LNG facility.

The Financial Times quoted a Novatek statement indicating the company signed a memorandum of understanding with Polar Train in April of this year and said that executing a project of this scale still requires the necessary approvals from both U.S. and Russian regulators.
A U.S. Treasury official said the department would not comment on allegations of sanctions violations but would "take any potential breaches extremely seriously."

Meanwhile, Polar Train LNG’s operating company has appointed former Goldman Sachs Russia bank CEO Tim Talkington as interim CEO, and the company noted that Talkington is also president of its parent, Polar Eagle LNG.
Polar LNG aims to begin transporting natural gas from Alaska’s North Slope by the end of 2030.
(This article is not available for partner re‑publication)

items.title: 高盛示警：AI恐取代9%勞工！經濟若衰退恐加劇裁員
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Warns: AI Could Replace 9% of Workers; Recession Could Accelerate Layoffs
paras: 人工智慧(AI)對就業市場的影響前景不容樂觀，根據高盛(Goldman Sachs)最新預測，最多可能有9%勞工被迫離開目前的工作崗位，相當於約1500萬名勞工的工作受到AI衝擊。
高盛首席經濟學家Jan Hatzius去年曾預測，AI可能取代美國6%至7%的勞工，但根據高盛更新後的預測，勞工遭取代的比率可能達到9%。
高盛的基本情境假設美國及其他已開發經濟體的生產力提高15%。

AI衝擊就業恐逐步升溫 經濟衰退可能加速自動化

報告指出，AI的採用也可能因整體招聘放緩而對就業市場造成壓力。不過，AI對整體失業率的影響，可能更多來自實際工作職位遭到裁撤，而非企業減少招聘。
Hatzius說：「根據我們對明年經濟成長接近潛在成長率的基本預測，估算結果顯示，AI對勞動市場的衝擊可能只會逐步擴大，而不是突然對就業市場造成衝擊。」
高盛預估，美國的AI採用仍處於初期階段，目前將AI納入日常工作流程的企業不到四分之一。
Hatzius表示，如果美國經濟陷入衰退，AI的採用速度可能加快。他援引高盛對過去經濟衰退期間自動化發展周期的分析指出，景氣下滑可能促使企業加速導入自動化技術。
他寫道：「我們分析中更令人擔憂的結論是，景氣循環放緩可能加速與AI相關的自動化及裁員，進而放大整體景氣循環的波動。」

AI裁員仍是企業縮編主因 入門白領工作面臨威脅

市場對AI可能造成失業的恐慌已略為降溫，但部分研究人員仍擔心，AI未來可能大幅削減入門級白領工作。
美國企業9月宣布的裁員數有所下降，但AI仍是企業最常提及的裁員原因，占所有已宣布裁員人數的21%。
根據Challenger, Gray & Christmas的數據，科技業的裁員情況也比其他任何產業嚴重，9月占所有裁員人數的29%。
paras_en: The impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on the labor market looks bleak; according to Goldman Sachs' latest forecast, up to 9% of workers could be forced out of their current jobs, roughly 15 million workers affected by AI.
Goldman Sachs chief economist Jan Hatzius last year predicted that AI might replace 6% to 7% of U.S. workers, but the updated forecast puts the replacement rate at as high as 9%.
Goldman's baseline scenario assumes a 15% productivity increase in the United States and other developed economies.

AI's impact on employment could gradually intensify, and an economic recession may speed up automation. The report notes that AI adoption could also strain the labor market as overall hiring slows, but the effect on the overall unemployment rate is likely to come more from actual job cuts than from firms hiring less.

Hatzius said, "Based on our baseline projection that next year's economic growth will be close to potential growth, the estimate shows that AI's impact on the labor market will likely expand gradually rather than shock the job market suddenly."
Goldman estimates that AI adoption in the United States is still in its early stage, with fewer than a quarter of firms currently integrating AI into daily workflows.

Hatzius added that if the U.S. economy falls into a recession, the pace of AI adoption could accelerate. He cited Goldman’s analysis of automation cycles during past downturns, noting that a slowdown in activity may prompt firms to speed up the deployment of automation technologies.
He wrote, "A more concerning conclusion from our analysis is that a slowdown in the business cycle could hasten AI‑related automation and layoffs, thereby amplifying overall economic volatility."

AI-driven layoffs remain a primary reason for corporate downsizing, putting entry‑level white‑collar jobs at risk. While market panic over AI‑induced unemployment has eased somewhat, some researchers still worry that AI could sharply cut entry‑level white‑collar positions in the future.
U.S. companies reported a slight decline in announced layoffs in September, but AI remained the most frequently cited reason for cuts, accounting for 21% of all announced layoffs.
According to data from Challenger, Gray & Christmas, the tech sector experienced the most severe layoffs of any industry, representing 29% of all layoffs in September.

items.title: 散戶抄底半導體股慘套牢！SOXL單周吸金61億美元、10月暴跌逾43%
items.title_en: Retail Investors Trapped in Bottom‑Buying Semiconductor Stocks! SOXL Draws $6.1 B in a Week, Falls Over 43% in October
paras: 美股半導體股跌勢加劇，押注反彈的散戶投資人反而面臨更大損失。FactSet數據顯示，追蹤半導體指數每日報酬3倍的槓桿型ETF Direxion 每日3倍看多半導體ETF(SOXL-US) 上周單周吸引創紀錄的61億美元資金流入，但晶片股不僅未如預期反彈，跌勢反而進一步擴大，讓進場抄底的資金迅速陷入虧損。
根據FactSet數據，SOXL上周單周流入61億美元，創下歷史新高。這檔ETF旨在提供半導體指數每日漲跌幅的3倍報酬，屬於風險較高的槓桿投資工具。
資金大舉湧入之際，半導體股已經歷一波下跌，市場對AI交易的熱情也開始降溫。部分投資人押注，股價跌幅愈大，短期反彈的機會就愈高。
然而，資金流入持續至周四，SOXL當天卻暴跌20.5%，創6月23日以來最大單日跌幅。SOXL本周再跌10.8%，連續第3周收黑，10月以來累計跌幅已超過43%。
相較之下，非槓桿型的安碩半導體ETF(SOXX-US) 當日下跌6.8%，跌幅明顯較小。
市場賣壓主要來自投資人對人工智慧（AI）投資回報的疑慮。隨著科技巨頭持續大舉投入AI基礎設施，市場開始重新檢視相關支出能否轉化為足夠的獲利，半導體股也因此承受估值壓力。
與此同時，美股三大指數周五（23日）全數收跌，標普500資訊科技類股更連續3周下跌，寫下自3月以來最長連跌紀錄。
受惠於AI晶片需求快速成長，半導體股今年以來曾大幅上漲，安碩半導體ETF年內一度飆升近59%。不過，隨著市場開始檢視AI基礎設施投資的實際回報，半導體股原有的漲勢正面臨挑戰。
財富管理公司Glenmede投資策略副總裁Mike Reynolds指出，半導體產業與AI基礎設施建設高度相關，目前市場對AI投資題材已出現一定程度的質疑。
他也認為，在股價經歷強勁上漲、估值大幅攀升後，投資人重新評估AI題材的潛在回報，屬於健康的市場現象。
Reynolds表示，與其等到市場熱潮完全脫離基本面後才提出疑問，投資人及早檢視相關投資的合理性，反而有助於市場調整。
分析指出，SOXL的表現再次凸顯槓桿ETF的風險。這類產品透過衍生性金融商品放大每日報酬，在市場上漲時可能帶來較高收益，但當行情走勢與投資方向相反時，損失也會迅速擴大。
10月以來，SOXL累計下跌逾43%，同期SOXX跌幅約15.9%，兩者差距反映3倍槓桿在下跌行情中的放大效果。
半導體股本月的劇烈波動，也多次影響標普500指數的單日表現，顯示AI投資情緒已成為牽動美股的重要因素。
對押注短期反彈的投資人而言，這波行情不僅是方向判斷失準，更凸顯槓桿產品的風險：當市場持續下跌，原本期待放大獲利的工具，也可能迅速放大虧損。
paras_en: The decline in U.S. semiconductor stocks has intensified, leaving retail investors who bet on a rebound facing even greater losses. FactSet data shows that the leveraged ETF tracking the semiconductor index at three times daily returns, Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X Shares (SOXL‑US), attracted a record $6.1 billion of inflows last week, yet chip stocks not only failed to rebound as expected but instead fell further, quickly turning the bottom‑buying capital into losses.

According to FactSet, SOXL drew $6.1 billion last week, setting a new historical high. This ETF aims to deliver three times the daily performance of the semiconductor index and is a high‑risk leveraged investment vehicle.

When the capital surged in, semiconductor stocks had already been on a downward trend, and enthusiasm for AI trading was cooling. Some investors bet that the larger the price decline, the higher the chance of a short‑term rebound.

However, the inflow continued until Thursday, when SOXL plunged 20.5% that day, its largest single‑day drop since June 23. SOXL fell 10.8% this week, marking its third consecutive week of losses, and its cumulative decline since October has exceeded 43%.
In contrast, the non‑leveraged iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX‑US) fell 6.8% that day, a noticeably smaller decline.

Market selling pressure mainly stemmed from investors’ doubts about the returns of AI investments. As tech giants continue to pour large sums into AI infrastructure, the market has begun to reassess whether such spending can translate into sufficient profits, putting valuation pressure on semiconductor stocks.

Meanwhile, all three U.S. major indices fell on Friday (23rd), and the S&P 500 Information Technology sector dropped for the third consecutive week, marking the longest streak of declines since March.

Benefiting from rapid growth in AI chip demand, semiconductor stocks have surged this year, with the iShares Semiconductor ETF soaring nearly 59% year‑to‑date. However, as the market starts to scrutinize the actual returns of AI infrastructure investments, the previous upward momentum of semiconductor stocks is facing challenges.

Mike Reynolds, Vice President of Investment Strategies at wealth‑management firm Glenmede, noted that the semiconductor industry is highly correlated with AI infrastructure construction, and that the market has begun to question the AI investment theme to some extent.
He also believes that after a strong rally and a significant rise in valuations, investors reassessing the potential returns of AI themes is a healthy market phenomenon.

Reynolds said that rather than waiting for the market hype to completely detach from fundamentals before raising questions, early scrutiny of the rationality of such investments actually helps the market adjust.

Analysis points out that SOXL’s performance again highlights the risks of leveraged ETFs. These products amplify daily returns through derivatives; they can yield higher gains when markets rise, but when the trend moves against the investment direction, losses can expand rapidly.
Since October, SOXL has fallen over 43% cumulatively, while SOXX has declined about 15.9% in the same period, reflecting the magnified effect of three‑times leverage in a downtrend.
The sharp volatility of semiconductor stocks this month has repeatedly impacted the daily performance of the S&P 500, showing that AI investment sentiment has become a key driver of U.S. equities.

For investors betting on a short‑term rebound, this market move not only reflects a misjudgment of direction but also underscores the risk of leveraged products: when the market continues to fall, tools that were expected to amplify gains can quickly amplify losses.

paras: 美元周五(23日)小幅上漲，美元指數本週變動不大。歐元則受法國政府公債遭拋售影響走低，法國債務風險溢酬升至2011年歐元區主權債務危機以來最高水準，歐元兌美元與日元均以週線收黑作收。日元受惠於週四AI概念股遭拋售引發的避險資金流入，兌美元本週上漲。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.25%，報101.82，本週上漲約0.03%。

Bannockburn Global Forex 首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler 表示，「今天歐洲債券市場的壓力已有所緩解，但穆迪稍晚對法國債務評等的檢視仍是一項挑戰。儘管馬克宏政府已威脅動用軍事力量平息社會動盪，但週末可能仍會有更多活動發生。」

央行政策會議成市場焦點

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Friday (the 23rd), with the DXY showing little change this week. The euro fell as French government bonds were sold off, pushing France's sovereign debt risk premium to its highest level since the Euro‑area crisis of 2011. Both the euro‑dollar and euro‑yen pairs closed the week in the red. The yen benefited from a flight‑to‑safety flow triggered by Thursday’s sell‑off in AI‑related stocks, rising against the dollar over the week.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.25% to 101.82, up about 0.03% for the week.

Market worries about escalating domestic turmoil in France and worsening budget issues continued to weigh on the euro. French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said France will deploy 70,000 police officers, supported by special forces, on Saturday to address protests. Moody’s also may downgrade France’s credit rating on Friday.

Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Global Forex, said, “The pressure on European bond markets has eased today, but Moody’s later review of France’s debt rating remains a challenge. Although the Macron government has threatened to use force to quell social unrest, more activity could still occur over the weekend.”
The euro fell 0.21% against the dollar to $1.1191, down about 0.43% for the week.
The euro‑yen pair slipped further, briefly hitting ¥175.08, the lowest since October 2025, down 0.11% and about 1.1% for the week.
The yen slipped 0.1% to ¥156.9 per dollar, but is up roughly 0.7% for the week, marking its best weekly performance since mid‑September.
Lee Hardman, senior FX analyst at MUFG, said, “With the hedge‑fund atmosphere heating up toward the end of the week, the yen remains firmly on the stronger side.”
Central‑bank policy meetings become market focus

Traders are watching next week’s policy meetings of the U.S. Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan. Markets expect all three central banks to keep rates unchanged, but investors will look for clues on future monetary‑policy direction.

According to data from the London Stock Exchange Group, after Thursday’s equity sell‑off, Fed‑funds futures traders reduced bets on a December rate hike, yet the market still sees an 81% probability of a hike.

Traders currently estimate a 66% chance that the ECB will raise rates in December. Investors will scrutinise any signals about the rate outlook. ECB President Christine Lagarde said at the end of September that a measured policy response to inflation is appropriate.

Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) data showed that euro‑area private‑sector growth slowed in October to its weakest level in four months, mainly dragged down by a renewed contraction in French economic activity.

Citigroup economist Giada Giani said, “We think this data dip brings the PMI back in line with other growth indicators rather than signalling rising downside risk. France remains a drag, but the rest of the euro area continues to show resilience.”

In Japan, Friday’s data showed that September core CPI year‑over‑year finally exceeded the Bank of Japan’s 2% inflation target for the first time in nine months. Analysts said the figure indicates price pressure spreading to more sectors and bolsters the case for a near‑term rate hike by the BOJ.
Traders now assign a 61% probability to a BOJ rate increase in December.

items.title: 美銀Hartnett示警避險潮延續至11月中 股市、美元、殖利率齊跌
items.title_en: Bank of America’s Hartnett Warns Hedge Wave Will Persist Into Mid‑November, Stocks, Dollar and Yields All Falling
paras: 美銀(BAC-US) 策略師Michael Hartnett預期，市場避險情緒可能延續至11月中旬，債券殖利率、股市與美元恐同步下跌。圍繞人工智慧（AI）交易及美國期中選舉的不安情緒，正壓抑股市表現，促使投資人轉向防禦性資產。
Hartnett週五在致客戶的報告中表示：「我們在戰術上維持避險立場至11月中旬。」他預期，市場將出現殖利率下跌、股市下跌及美元下跌的交易格局。
他指出，市場仍須充分反映民主黨同時取得眾議院與參議院控制權的可能性。在他看來，這樣的選舉結果將終結當前低稅、低監管的政策環境，不利企業獲利成長。
至於風險偏好何時可能回升，Hartnett認為，若歐洲央行或法國政府出手扭轉法國公債賣壓，可能成為訊號之一。
近期令市場不安的AI超大規模雲端服務商債券利差，也是一項觀察重點。他表示，若這些企業削減資本支出，或宣布「極大規模」的股權融資，使債券利差見頂，也可能緩解市場壓力。
儘管疑慮升溫，資金仍持續流入AI相關領域。美銀引述EPFR Global數據指出，科技股獲得7月以來最大單週資金流入。美銀本月公布的調查也顯示，全球投資人對科技股的曝險程度，升至2020年8月以來最高。
不過，最近幾天投資人也開始轉向防禦性資產，以因應油價上漲、融資成本攀升，以及AI交易可能逐漸泡沫化等風險。億萬富豪肯．格里芬（Ken Griffin）本週便警告，投資人「幾乎可以肯定」正身處AI泡沫之中。
資金轉向的跡象也反映在類股表現上。作為衡量市場廣度的指標，標普500等權重指數週四相對於市值加權的標普500指數，創下2024年以來最佳單日表現；防禦性較強的民生必需消費品類股，則可望締造1998年以來最佳單月表現。
paras_en: Bank of America (BAC-US) strategist Michael Hartnett expects the market’s hedging sentiment to continue into mid‑November, with bond yields, equities and the dollar likely to fall together. Anxiety surrounding AI‑driven trading and the U.S. midterm elections is suppressing stock performance and pushing investors toward defensive assets.

Hartnett wrote in a client note on Friday: “We will maintain a tactical hedging stance through mid‑November.” He anticipates a trading environment of falling yields, declining equities and a weaker dollar.

He noted that the market still needs to fully price in the possibility that Democrats could control both the House and the Senate. In his view, such an outcome would end the current low‑tax, low‑regulation policy regime, which is unfavorable for corporate profit growth.
As for when risk appetite might rebound, Hartnett sees a potential signal if the European Central Bank or the French government steps in to curb the selling pressure on French sovereign bonds.

Another focus is the widening credit spreads of ultra‑large AI cloud service providers, which have recently unsettled markets. He said that if these firms cut capital expenditures or announce “massive” equity financings that cap spreads, market pressure could ease.

Despite rising concerns, money continues to flow into AI‑related areas. Bank of America cites EPFR Global data showing the biggest weekly inflow into tech stocks since July, and its own survey this month indicating global investors’ exposure to tech stocks has risen to its highest level since August 2020.

However, in recent days investors have begun shifting toward defensive assets to hedge against rising oil prices, higher financing costs and the potential bubble in AI trading. Billionaire Ken Griffin warned this week that investors are “almost certainly” in an AI bubble.

The shift is also reflected in sector performance. As a breadth gauge, the equal‑weight S&P 500 posted its best single‑day performance this year on Thursday relative to the market‑cap‑weighted S&P 500, while defensive consumer‑staples stocks are on track for their strongest monthly gain since 1998.

paras: 美元周四(22日)大致持平，日元則有望創下近一個月來最大單日漲幅。由於股市表現脆弱、中東戰事延宕推升原油價格，以及市場對人工智慧（AI）未來投資報酬的疑慮升高，投資人紛紛尋求避險。

在葉門武裝組織青年運動（Houthi）攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯後，市場擔心這個重要能源出口地區的供應將進一步受到干擾，推動油價上漲約3%，升至五個月高點。

Convera首席外匯與總體經濟策略師Kevin Ford將此稱為「干預溢價」，並指出，「每當日元接近160關卡，市場對央行出手干預的猜測就會升溫。」

paras_en: The dollar was roughly flat on Thursday (the 22nd), while the yen is poised to record its biggest single‑day gain in about a month. Weak equity markets, lingering Middle‑East conflict pushing up oil prices, and growing doubts about the future returns on artificial‑intelligence (AI) investments have led investors to seek safe havens.

The euro fell 0.09% against the dollar to $1.1222. Concerns over social unrest in France and the country’s deteriorating fiscal outlook outweighed worries about AI‑driven trading, which has been dragging U.S. equities lower.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.08% to 101.60.
Chris Scicluna, head of economic research at Daiwa Capital Markets, said, “AI is unsettling, oil prices are too… the situation in France is equally worrisome.”
After a Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia, markets feared further supply disruptions in this key energy‑export region, pushing oil prices up about 3% to a five‑month high.
The yen rose 0.75% against the dollar to ¥156.96 per $1.

One reason for the yen’s strength may be its approach to the critical ¥160 level. Market participants think that once the yen nears ¥160, Japanese authorities are more likely to intervene in the forex market to support the currency.

Kevin Ford, chief FX and macro strategist at Convera, called this an “intervention premium” and noted, “Whenever the yen approaches the 160 barrier, speculation about central‑bank intervention heats up.”
On another traditional safe‑haven currency, the Swiss franc, the dollar fell 0.42% to 0.821 CHF per $1.

The dollar’s trajectory is increasingly shaped by capital flows and expectations for economic growth and inflation linked to AI trading. Last week, heightened doubts about AI’s outlook pulled the dollar down, but on Thursday market concerns over France took precedence.

Erik Nelson, global FX strategy head at Wells Fargo, said, “There are competing market narratives and fragile points right now: on one side, U.S. AI‑related credit risk; on the other, France’s sovereign credit risk. In recent days these two factors have been tug‑of‑war, with one sometimes outweighing the other.”
He added, “As long as France’s risk is more concerning to the market than U.S. AI‑related credit risk, the euro will remain relatively weak.”
French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that “illegal” protests would be banned in the coming days, blaming last weekend’s riots and looting on “subversive” far‑left groups and vandals.

Market doubts about France’s ability to manage its massive debt load have hit French government bonds and sparked worries about other highly indebted euro‑area countries. On Thursday the spread between French and German 10‑year yields widened to 177.7 basis points, the widest since 2011.

items.title_en: Philippine Central Bank Unexpectedly Raises Rate by 2 Points, Signaling Determination to Combat Inflation and Peso Depreciation
paras: 菲律賓央行(BSP)周四(22日)採取果斷行動，宣布將目標反向附買回利率調升2碼(0.5個百分點)至5.50%，以應對通膨擴大與披索匯率跌至歷史新低的雙重壓力，這項決策遠比市場預期更為激進。
媒體先前調查的25位經濟學家中，多達24位僅預估升息1碼，僅有1位準確預估升息2碼。央行在聲明中表示，價格壓力擴大需要「強烈」的回應，透過決斷的貨幣政策來遏制二次效應並錨定通膨預期，且已做好必要時採取進一步貨幣政策行動的準備。
自今年早些時候伊朗爆發衝突以來，儘管菲律賓經濟正經歷疫情以來最慢的成長步伐，央行已累計升息125個基點(5碼)。然而通膨前景未見顯著改善，9月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率衝上7.2%，扭轉了連續4個月的放緩趨勢，使今年以來的平均通膨率達到5.4%，遠高於央行3%的目標。
此外，披索對美元匯率在上周跌破63關卡後續創新低，加劇了依賴進口能源與食品的進口通膨風險。央行維持今年通膨預測於6.1%，但將2027年預測由5.4%顯著調升至6.0%，預計要到2028年才會降至3.3%。
菲律賓央行總裁雷莫洛納(Eli Remolona)表示：「通膨預測比我們預想的還要糟糕，這讓我們感受到壓制通膨壓力的緊迫感。」
雷莫洛納指出，中東局勢升溫推升了國際油價與運輸票價，而未來最大的風險是嚴重的聖嬰現象乾旱可能衝擊農業生產。他同時對披索疲軟及其對進口通膨的影響表達憂慮，但明確表示央行不會耗盡外匯存底來捍衛特定的匯率關卡，並補充指出，在政府支出改善下，國內經濟預計於2027年第一季復甦。
做為唯一精準預測本次決策的專家，菲律賓群島銀行首席經濟學家Emilio Neri Jr.認為，這次大幅升息強化了菲律賓央行對抗通膨的信譽與決心。
不過，Pantheon Macroeconomics經濟學家Miguel Chanco提醒，12月會議是否進一步緊縮仍非定局。他說：「今日超出預期的調整，其動機可能是將今年最後一次會議中原本無爭議的25個基點升息提前實施。」
paras_en: The Philippine central bank (BSP) took decisive action on Thursday (the 22nd), announcing a 2‑point (0.5 percentage‑point) increase in its target reverse repurchase rate to 5.50% to address the dual pressures of widening inflation and the peso sliding to a historic low, a move far more aggressive than markets had expected.

Among the 25 economists surveyed by the media, 24 only forecast a 1‑point hike, with just one correctly predicting a 2‑point increase. In its statement, the bank said that expanding price pressures require a “strong” response, using decisive monetary policy to curb secondary effects and anchor inflation expectations, and it is ready to take further policy action if needed.

Since the outbreak of conflict in Iran earlier this year, even as the Philippine economy has been growing at its slowest pace since the pandemic, the central bank has cumulatively raised rates by 125 basis points (5 points). Yet the inflation outlook has not improved markedly; September’s consumer price index (CPI) rose 7.2% year‑on‑year, reversing four months of slowdown and pushing the year‑to‑date average inflation to 5.4%, well above the bank’s 3% target.

Moreover, after the peso fell below the 63 per‑dollar mark last week and set a new low, import‑driven inflation risks have intensified given the country’s reliance on imported energy and food. The bank kept its 2024 inflation forecast at 6.1% but lifted its 2027 projection sharply from 5.4% to 6.0%, expecting inflation to fall to 3.3% only by 2028.
BSP Governor Eli Remolona said, “The inflation outlook is worse than we anticipated, which makes us feel the urgency of suppressing inflation pressures.”

Remolona noted that heightened tensions in the Middle East have pushed up international oil prices and freight rates, and that the biggest future risk is a severe El Niño‑induced drought that could hit agricultural output. He also expressed concern over the weak peso and its impact on imported inflation, but made clear the bank will not deplete foreign‑exchange reserves to defend a specific exchange‑rate level, adding that, with improved government spending, the domestic economy is expected to recover in the first quarter of 2027.

As the only expert who accurately forecast the decision, Emilio Neri Jr., chief economist at the Bank of the Philippine Islands, said the sharp rate hike reinforces the BSP’s credibility and resolve in fighting inflation.

However, Pantheon Macroeconomics economist Miguel Chanco warned that whether the December meeting will tighten further remains uncertain. He said, “Today’s surprise adjustment may be motivated by moving forward the undisputed 25‑basis‑point hike that was slated for the last meeting of the year.”

items.title: 人工智慧疑慮再起 資金湧入美債、日元與瑞郎避險
items.title_en: AI Concerns Resurface, Funds Flood Into US Treasuries, Yen and Franc as Safe Havens
paras: 由於投資人對人工智慧(AI)交易的獲利前景疑慮再起，導致股市出現震盪，避險資金隨之湧入美國公債、日元及瑞士法郎等避險資產。
美國政府公債殖利率全線下跌至少 3 個基點，其中 30 年期美債殖利率降至 5.38%，創下 9 月 23 日以來最低。同時，澳洲與紐西蘭公債價格也同步走揚，日元兌美元匯率升幅高達 0.3%。
星展銀行(DBS Bank Ltd.)資深利率策略師 Eugene Leow 表示：「隨著投資人重新審視與 AI 相關的資產，近期的市場情緒似乎更加動搖。」他指出，市場對獲利能力與投資報酬率(ROI)的疑慮正在逐漸浮現。在美債殖利率以近期標準衡量仍處於高位的情況下，投資人希望透過轉向美債尋求安全感，以規避部分風險。
股票市場的跌勢，讓美債重新發揮了避險資產的作用；在此之前，對通膨升溫的擔擔曾推動美債殖利率在最近幾周升至多年新高。
儘管沙烏地阿拉伯發生的致命襲擊事件引發市場對供應前景的疑慮，進而推升原油價格，但資金對美債的避險買盤依然強勁。能源成本上升加深了市場對通膨的擔憂，並促使交易員預期美國聯準會(Fed)及全球其他主要中央銀行將進一步升息。
彭博追蹤美債報酬率的指標在 9 月創下近兩年來最大單月跌幅後，10 月已回升約 1.2%。
澳洲國家銀行(National Australia Bank)利率策略主管 Kenneth Crompton 對此指出：「儘管油價一直在緩步上揚，但美債再次吸引了避險資金的流入。」
除美債外，全球其他主要債市與匯市也受到影響。澳洲 10 年期公債殖利率下跌 3 個基點至 5.25%，紐西蘭 2 年期公債殖利率下滑 2 個基點至 3.91%。在匯市方面，日元兌美元升值 0.3% 至 157.68 日元兌 1 美元，瑞士法郎上漲 0.2%，而美元指數指標則變化不大。
法國Credit Agricole策略師 David Forrester 分析：「標普 500 指數期貨的回檔為日元帶來了推升力道。」他強調：「重要之處在於，這種升勢是全面性的，甚至對美元同樣上揚，這凸顯出在 AI 熱潮遭遇波折時，日元所具備的避險資產地位。」
paras_en: Investors' renewed doubts about the profit prospects of AI trading have caused stock market volatility, prompting safe‑haven money to pour into US government bonds, the Japanese yen and the Swiss franc.

US government bond yields fell across the board by at least three basis points, with the 30‑year Treasury yield dropping to 5.38%, the lowest since September 23. At the same time, Australian and New Zealand government bond prices rose, and the yen gained about 0.3% against the dollar.

Eugene Leow, senior rate strategist at DBS Bank Ltd., said: “As investors re‑evaluate AI‑related assets, market sentiment has become more unsettled.” He noted that concerns over profitability and ROI are emerging, and with Treasury yields still high by recent standards, investors are turning to US bonds for safety and to hedge some risk.
The equity market decline has restored the role of Treasuries as a safe‑haven asset; previously, worries about rising inflation had pushed Treasury yields up to multi‑year highs in recent weeks.

Although a deadly attack in Saudi Arabia raised supply‑side concerns and lifted oil prices, buying pressure for US Treasuries remained strong. Higher energy costs have deepened inflation worries and led traders to expect further rate hikes from the US Federal Reserve and other major central banks worldwide.
Bloomberg’s Treasury yield index, after posting the biggest monthly drop in nearly two years in September, has recovered about 1.2% in October.
Kenneth Crompton, head of rate strategy at National Australia Bank, said: “Even though oil prices have been inching higher, US Treasuries are once again attracting safe‑haven flows.”

Beyond Treasuries, other major bond and currency markets were also affected. Australian 10‑year government bond yields fell three basis points to 5.25%, New Zealand two‑year yields slipped two basis points to 3.91%. In the FX market, the yen appreciated 0.3% to 157.68 per dollar, the Swiss franc rose 0.2%, while the US dollar index was largely unchanged.

David Forrester, a strategist at Credit Agricole in France, analyzed: “The pull‑back in S&P 500 futures provided upward momentum for the yen.” He stressed: “The key point is that this rise is broad‑based, even lifting the dollar, highlighting the yen’s safe‑haven status when the AI hype hits a snag.”

items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: RBA’s Hawkish Stance Fuels Aussie Dollar Rise
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國9月獨棟住宅建設大幅下滑及未來建設指標建築許可降至三年半低點，並據多名伊朗官員表示有意拖延與美國談判，試圖削弱美國總統川普在11月期中選舉選情，而且美國公債收益率下滑，削減美元吸引力，週三令美元承壓；此外，路透調查顯示，多數經濟學家預計日本央行(BOJ)在12月上調利率至1.50%及維持每季升息一次的節奏，而且日本政府公布9月進、出口分別較上年同期增長18.9%和16.7%低於預期，但得益於半導體和人工智能(AI)相關產品需求強勁，出口連續十三個月實現增長，貿易逆差則縮窄至5,366億日圓，而且日本財務大臣片山皋月指出，進口成本上升推動日本經濟面臨物價上漲，且即將進入由工資上漲驅動的持續通貨膨脹時期，政府將與BOJ保持密切溝通，雙方在通貨膨脹前景與政策方面無重大分歧，激勵日圓上漲，美元兌日圓自158.39高點下滑。

隨著日本長期公債收益率延續漲勢，正吸引日本資本加劇回流，並據BOJ副總裁冰見野良三表示，燃料和原材料價格上漲推高物價，且全球AI需求旺盛對物價形成上行壓力，認為日本基礎通貨膨脹率已相當接近央行的2%目標，表明BOJ已準備好上調借貸成本，擴大美元兌日圓跌幅至157.82低點，但美國和以色列與伊朗之間的衝突加劇，市場波動性上升及引發對能源供應中斷的擔憂，而且美國原油燃料庫存下降提供額外支持，國際原油價格上漲，限制美元走低。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於158.20-40，支撐於157.30-50。
◆EUR/USD
澳洲央行(RBA)副總裁豪澤昨日表示，貨幣緊縮正在使經濟放緩，但原油價格高企令通貨膨脹惡化，讓其不確定下個月是否需要進一步加息，目前市場預計RBA於11月加息的概率升至約50%，激勵澳幣漲至三周高點，帶動歐元兌美元自1.1211低點上漲。
據法國十年期公債收益率升至2002年以來最高，突顯法國範圍廣泛的抗議活動加劇脆弱財政狀況和政治不確定的擔憂，但歐洲央行(ECB)首席經濟學家連恩稱，ECB可以通過向外國提供流動性安全網來加強歐元全球地位及擴大其貨幣政策的影響，推動歐元兌美元觸及1.1240高點。預估今日歐元兌美元支撐於1.1200-20，阻力於1.1280-1.1300。
◆GBP/USD

週三英國國家統計局公布9月扣除國有銀行的公共部門淨借款升至245億英鎊再超過預期及公共債務總額突破3兆英鎊，料給予英國財政大臣希利下周提交其首份預算案蒙上陰影，拖累英鎊兌美元下滑至1.3361低點。隨後英國數據顯示8月房屋價格較去年同期漲0.9%，創3月以來最低，但伊朗戰爭引發能源價格飆升，英國9月消費者物價指數(CPI)較上年同期升3.5%，生產者物價指數(PPI)投入與產出物價則分別較去年同期漲8.3%及4.6%皆超過預期，強化英國央行(BOE)於11月5日會議上調利率至4.00%的臆測，提振英鎊兌美元1.3403高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元支撐於1.3350-70，阻力於1.3440-60。

U.S. September single‑family home construction fell sharply and future construction permits dropped to a three‑and‑a‑half‑year low. Multiple Iranian officials say they intend to delay talks with the United States to weaken President Trump’s prospects in the November mid‑term elections. Meanwhile U.S. Treasury yields fell, reducing the dollar’s appeal and putting pressure on the greenback on Wednesday. Reuters surveys show most economists expect the Bank of Japan (BOJ) to raise rates to 1.50% in December and keep a quarterly‑hike rhythm. Japan’s government reported September imports and exports grew 18.9% and 16.7% year‑on‑year, respectively, below expectations, but strong demand for semiconductor and AI‑related products kept exports up for a 13th consecutive month while the trade deficit narrowed to ¥536.6 billion. Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki noted rising import costs are pushing Japanese prices higher and that the economy is entering a wage‑driven, sustained inflation phase. The government will stay in close contact with the BOJ, and both sides see no major disagreement on inflation outlook or policy, supporting yen gains as the USD/JPY pair fell from its ¥158.39 high.

As long‑term Japanese government bond yields continue to rise, they are attracting capital back to Japan. BOJ Deputy Governor Masayoshi Amamiya said higher fuel and raw‑material prices are lifting inflation, and robust global AI demand adds upward pressure on prices. He believes Japan’s core inflation is now close to the BOJ’s 2% target, indicating the central bank is ready to raise borrowing costs, widening the USD/JPY decline to a ¥157.82 low. However, escalating conflict between the United States, Israel and Iran is raising market volatility and fears of energy‑supply disruptions, while falling U.S. crude inventories are supporting higher oil prices, limiting the dollar’s fall. The pair’s resistance is projected at 158.20‑40 and support at 157.30‑50 today.
EUR/USD

RBA Deputy Governor Guy Debelle said yesterday that monetary tightening is slowing the Australian economy, but high oil prices are worsening inflation, leaving him uncertain whether another rate hike will be needed next month. The market now sees roughly a 50% chance of an RBA hike in November, pushing the Aussie dollar to a three‑week high and lifting the euro‑dollar pair from its ¥1.1211 low.

French 10‑year bond yields have risen to their highest level since 2002, highlighting concerns that widespread protests are worsening France’s fiscal fragility and political uncertainty. ECB chief economist Philip Lane said the ECB can bolster the euro’s global standing and expand its policy influence by offering liquidity backstops to foreign markets, helping the euro‑dollar pair reach a ¥1.1240 peak. The euro is expected to find support at 1.1200‑20 and face resistance at 1.1280‑1.1300 today.
GBP/USD

The UK Office for National Statistics released September data showing net borrowing by the public sector (excluding state‑owned banks) rose to £24.5 billion, exceeding expectations, and total public debt topped £3 trillion. This clouds Chancellor Jeremy Hunt’s first budget slated for next week and drags the pound down to a ¥1.3361 low against the dollar. Subsequent UK data showed August house prices rose 0.9% year‑on‑year, the weakest since March, while the Iran‑related war drove energy prices higher. September CPI rose 3.5% YoY and PPI input and output prices jumped 8.3% and 4.6% respectively, both above forecasts, strengthening speculation that the Bank of England will raise rates to 4.00% at its November 5 meeting and lifting the pound to a ¥1.3403 high. The pound’s support today is 1.3350‑70 and resistance 1.3440‑60.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元下跌 交易員等待Fed下週決策
items.title_en: <New York Forex Market> Dollar Falls as Traders Await Fed Decision Next Week
paras: 美元周三(21日)下跌，交易員評估油價上漲再度引發的通膨風險，並等待聯準會(Fed)下週召開會議。澳幣則因央行官員發表偏緊縮言論而走強。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.14%，報101.65。
加拿大豐業銀行首席外匯策略師Shaun Osborne表示，「目前市場並沒有一個主導全局的明確主題……我認為這種情況至少會持續到下週聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議前。我們需要了解聯準會的想法。」
美國與伊朗持續交戰，加深了市場對油價推升通膨可能影響聯準會政策的擔憂。
聯邦基金利率期貨交易員認為，聯準會下週升息的可能性不高，下一次升息預計將落在12月。聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)也不太可能暗示未來的政策走向。
不過，Osborne表示，「我認為，下週市場至少會進一步評估未來升息的可能時間點，相關預期也會變得更加明確。」
投資人也擔心AI交易行情還能持續多久。
儘管上週數據顯示美國9月消費者物價通膨加速，美元仍然走弱。先前市場對AI產業的樂觀情緒吸引資金流入美國，並推升經濟成長與通膨預期，為美元提供支撐。
CIBC Capital Markets外匯策略師Noah Buffam表示，「美國經濟成長很大程度上是由整體AI交易行情所帶動。這也使通膨持續高於目標水準，因此AI對美國的影響比對其他國家更大。」
馬斯克週二表示，合併旗下SpaceX與特斯拉是「一個好主意」，而SpaceX也公布上市以來首次獲利，部分緩解了市場對股市的疑慮。
另一方面，AI伺服器製造商美超微（Super Micro）預估，季營收與利潤率將高於華爾街預期。
歐元兌美元上漲0.01%，至1.1237美元。
法國大規模反政府抗議活動，以及日益惡化的財政前景，持續對歐元造成壓力。法國10年期公債借貸成本週三升至24年來高點。
Saxo全球宏觀策略主管John Hardy表示，「法國的債務問題難以處理。他們確實需要採取適當的財政調整措施，降低債務水準，至少要展現出對債務發展趨勢的重視。」
法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)承諾，將防止上週末的暴動與掠奪事件再次發生。同時，黃背心運動(Yellow Vest)已提出計畫，準備於週六在巴黎舉行大型遊行，這將成為法國政府面臨的下一項重大考驗。
其他貨幣方面，澳洲央行(RBA)副總裁Andrew Hauser在花旗集團一場會議上表示，通膨前景「明顯惡化」，帶動澳幣走強。
澳幣兌美元上漲0.41%，至0.7031美元。
英鎊兌美元上漲0.16%，至1.34美元。數據顯示，英國9月通膨升幅高於預期，進一步強化了英格蘭銀行(BoE)11月升息的理由。
英鎊兌歐元則升至17個月來最高水準。
日元兌美元上漲0.02%，至158.12日元。日本央行(BoJ)副總裁冰見野良三(Ryozo Himino)表示，日本潛在通膨已接近央行2%的目標，金融環境仍寬鬆，暗示未來仍有提高借貸成本的空間。
